name: Neewer QZ-S Touchscreen TTL Wireless Flash Trigger for Canon
short_description:
Key Features
  • Works with 2.4 GHz Wireless Q System
  • For Select canon Cameras
  • TTL, M/Manual, TCM Switch & Strobe Mode
  • High-Speed, 1st & 2nd Curtain Sync
  • Adjustable EV, Buzzer & Memory Function
  • Runs on Internal Rechargeable Battery
  • 2.5-Hour Charging Time
  • Intuitive OLED Touchscreen
  • Includes USB-C Cable
  • Includes Storage Bag
description:
Neewer QZ-S Touchscreen TTL Wireless Flash Trigger for Canon Overview

The QZ-S Touchscreen TTL Wireless Flash Trigger from Neewer is designed to trigger various Q-system-compatible flashes in the studio or on location. Neewer’s Q wireless system enables five groups, 32 channels, and up to 99 IDs within 328′ at a 2.4 GHz frequency—providing fast response and a stable transmission. The QZ-S provides TTL, manual, TCM switch, and strobe modes, as well as +/-3 EV exposure compensation. Connect it to your camera’s hot shoe and secure it using the quick lock mechanism. It operates using an integrated rechargeable battery using the included USB-cable. Full charging is achieved in 2.5 hours. The QZ-S is compact at 2.5 x 1.6 x 1.5″ and lightweight at 2.1 oz for greater portability. A storage bag is also included for safe transport of the trigger.

Versatility
Multiple highlights include TTL automatic flash, 1/8000 sec high speed sync, flash exposure compensation (FEC), manual flash, one-click TCM switch (TTL to manual), stroboscopic flash, modeling lamp control, zooming, single point triggering, group control, and more.
Multiple Flash Modes
The manual mode offers precise flash output adjustments from 1/128 to 1/1, with the S1/S2 modes for wireless triggering. Other functions are auto or manual zoom settings with adjustability from 20mm to 200mm. The QZ supports single-point triggering for precise control over your shots.
OLED Touchscreen
A convenient OLED touchscreen facilitates local control, and you can even adjust the screen brightness.
Built-In Lithium Battery
Thanks to its internal 3.7V, 1000mAh lithium battery, the QZ can be fully charged in 2.5 hours using the included USB-C cable and an optional adapter. Take advantage of a battery level indicator that helps you monitor power status at a glance.
Flash Compatibility
Wirelessly trigger Neewer’s separately available NW420-C, Z1-C, Z2-C, Z760-C, Z880-C, NW760-C, Z2PRO-C, S101-300W Pro, S101-400W Pro, S102-400W Pro, NW655-C, and Q-C (only off camera triggering). Users can also control other flashes without a built-in Q system via an optional QR receiver and a 2.5mm sync cord.
Sony Camera Compatibility
Sony a9 III, a9 II, a9, a7R V, a7R IV, a7 IV, a7R III, a7S III, a7 III, a7S II, a7R II, a7 II, a7S, a7, a7C II, a7C, a1, a1 II, a6700, a6600, a6500, a6400, a6100, a6000, ZV-E10, and ZV-E1.
Additional Details
  • Channel scanning function
  • Buzzer control via trigger
  • Memory function
  • Firmware upgrades via the USB-C port
  • Disable the single contact mode for TTL and strobe modes

short_description:
Key Features
  • Compatible with Canon TTL
  • Output: 100Ws
  • Expanded 2.4 GHz Wireless System
  • Works with Neewer Q & Godox X System
  • Two Built-In LED Modeling Lights
  • Round Flash Head Design, TCM Capability
  • Tilts -7 to 120°, Rotates 330°
  • 1.7 sec Recycle & 500 Full-Power Flashes
  • High-Speed, 1st & 2nd Curtain, RPT Sync
  • Includes Battery & USB-C Cable
description:
Neewer Z3R-C TTL Round Head Flash Speedlite for Canon Overview

00:43
Introducing the NEEWER Z3R 100Ws 2.4G TTL Round Head Flash Speedlite
06:14
Z3R: Setup & Operation Guide

Easily illuminate a range of scenes with the shoe-mounted Neewer Z3R-C TTL Round Head Flash Speedlite from Neewer. The Z3R offers a powerful 100Ws output with super-efficient cooling, enabling a 1.7-second recycle time and up to 100 continuous flashes at full power. An internal 3000mAh battery supports up to 500 full-power flashes. Thanks to the dual 2.4 GHz wireless system, the Z3R is compatible with the Neewer Q system and functions as a slave light in the Godox X system. Two built-in 3300K LED modeling lights are incorporated, and built-in TCM conversion makes it easy to quickly switch from TTL to manual flash mode.

Uniform Light Quality
Compatible with select cameras with Canon TTL automatic functionality, the Z3R features a round head that provides a soft, smooth light with gradual falloff that easily illuminates your scene. The Z3R has a zoom range from 28 to 105mm along with the ability to rotate 330° and tilt -7 to 120° to achieve the perfect lighting angle.
Multiple Flash Modes
The Z3R packs multiple modes of operation, including manual mode for customizing your exposure. Users will also appreciate a variety of automated flash settings, such as stroboscopic flash, 1st and 2nd curtain sync, as well as the ability to use 1/8000 sec high-speed sync.
Fast Recycling & Battery Power
With recycle times of up to 1.7 sec, the unit is powered by an 3000mAh rechargeable battery that ensures long-lasting shoots. The Z3R will give you up to 500 full-power flashes with a flash duration between 1/180 and 1/20,000 sec for freezing fast action. Alternatively, the Z3R is capable of 70-100 continuous flashes at full power for burst shooting. The included battery has a USB-C port for external charging in 2.5 hours using a separately available fast charging adapter.
Dual LED Modeling Lamps
Two 2W LED modeling lamps offer 10 adjustable brightness levels. These integrated 3300K lamps are continuous light sources that are useful to see how the flash’s light will fall on your subject.
Powerful 2.4 GHz Wireless System
The Z3R’s 2.4 GHz wireless system enables four groups, 32 channels, and 99 IDs with the separately available QPRO-N TTL transmitters. It can be used to control other flashes with a transmission range of up to 328′ with no obstacles. These 32 channels and four groups avoid interference with other shooters to fire each flash separately for complex setups. The Z3R is also compatible as a slave light with the Godox 2.4 GHz X wireless system and the separately available XPro, X2, and X3 transmitters. It also works with an optional Sekonic L-858D light meter (RT-GX module). It is important to note that the Neewer Q and Godox X systems cannot be used simultaneously, and the latest firmware is required for compatibility.
Additional Details
  • Supports USB firmware updates via USB-C port
  • Included magnetic dome diffuser easily attaches to the magnetic flash head
  • Large high-definition color touch screen for convenient onboard control

name: GoPro HERO13 Black with Ultrawide Lens Mod Bundle
short_description:
Key Feat

  • 1/1.9″ sensor captures 5.3K60, 4K120, and 2.7K240 video with 27MP photos

  • Includes Ultra Wide Lens Mod with an expanded 177° field of view

  • HyperSmooth 6.0 image stabilization delivers smooth, steady footage

  • HB-Series lens compatibility with tool-free lens installation and removal

  • Front and rear LCD screens with an upgraded mounting ecosystem
description:
GoPro HERO13 Black with Ultrawide Lens Mod Bundle Overview

The GoPro HERO13 Black Camera with Ultra Wide Lens Mod delivers exceptional image quality and versatile shooting capabilities for action, adventure, and content creation. Featuring a 1/1.9″ sensor, it captures stunning 5.3K video at 60fps, 4K video at 120fps, and 27MP photos. The included Ultra Wide Lens Mod expands the field of view to 177°, making it ideal for immersive POV footage and expansive landscapes. With HyperSmooth 6.0 image stabilization, an upgraded mounting system, and front and rear LCD screens, the HERO13 Black offers a flexible and reliable shooting experience

HyperSmooth 6.0 with AutoBoost
Upgraded HyperSmooth 6.0 features AutoBoost performance that reduces image cropping, which might otherwise compromise your framing. 360° Horizon Lock keeps your footage steady and level, even if your camera rotates completely.
Widescreen, Vertical, and Full Screen Capture
Toggle between widescreen 16:9, 9:16 vertical, and 8:7 full-frame aspect ratios for a variety of shooting applications. The full-frame option captures a 156° FOV that lets you crop in to create widescreen and vertical shots in post.
10-Bit Color & Log Encoding
Choose between standard 10-bit video or Log encoding at 10-bit with GP-Log for enhanced color depth, smoother gradations, and reliable color reproduction. Advanced users can use GP-Log to get more detail while making necessary image corrections in post.
HB-Series Lens Compatibility
Purchase separately available HB-series lenses to specialize your footage for a variety of creative shots. The Ultra Wide Lens Mod provides a POV lens for action-packed scenes and landscapes. The Macro Lens Mod captures close-ups with incredible detail. Use the neutral density filters to add motion blur to your footage without compromising exposure. The Anamorphic Lens Mod helps you achieve pro-level cinematics. Once attached, the HERO13 Black automatically detects the lens or filter and adjusts its settings accordingly.
Burst Slo-Mo
New Burst Slo-Mo captures footage where action is slowed down to 13x its normal speed. You can also record short 4x slo-mo clips in 5.3K resolution video to catch details you might have missed on first shot.
Timecode Sync
If you own more than one HERO13 Black, you can easily sync the camera timecode to make multi-camera editing a breeze. This feature is compatible with Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere, and other editing software to streamline postproduction.
Bluetooth Audio Connectivity
Connect the HERO13 Black to compatible Bluetooth devices like a wireless microphone to record improved audio. You can even connect wireless headphones to either monitor your recorded audio or facilitate voice commands in noisy settings. Hear camera alerts through your headphones to confirm the HERO13 Black received the command. Use the Audio Tuning feature to adjust sound recording with easy for balanced delivery between atmospheric sound and vocals.
QuikCapture
Just press the shutter button on your HERO13 Black to quickly start your camera. You can also set your camera to idle without completely powering down to preserve battery.
Pro or Easy Control Modes
Choose between point-and-shoot simplicity or full camera control using the camera’s two control modes. Easy control allows you to frame your shot and hit the shutter button for a one-and-done shooting solution. Tap the 2.27″ rear touchscreen to toggle between widescreen and mobile shots, slow motion, night effects, and other adjustments. Pro controls unlock the ability to fine-tune all modes, settings, and features to then set as a preset.
GoPro Quik App
Easy-to-use tools allow you to edit your footage, tweak automatically generated highlight videos, or make your own videos from scratch. Change digital lenses after recording, zoom in on the best frames, and create thumbnails for your next social media post or YouTube video. Wirelessly upload video to your Quik app without needing to use the USB-C connection on the camera. GPS automatically captures data that can be overlaid as graphics onto your video. Create presets of your go-to settings for easy recall.
Faster Transferring & Unlimited Cloud Backup
Transfer content via Wi-Fi 6 to the cloud for more reliable offloads. Use the USB-C port for a wired connection option or an SD card to transfer content to a computer. Unlimited cloud storage can be accessed with a GoPro subscription, just plug your camera in when connected to your home Wi-Fi.
Night Effects and Time Lapse
  • Star Trails uses Earth’s rotation to create light trails with the stars in the sky.
  • Light Painting converts moving light into brushstrokes.
  • Vehicle Light Trails records the movement of nighttime traffic lights.
More Enhanced Features
  • In-camera Power Tools maximize your battery life. HindSight captures up to 30 seconds of footage before you start recording. Scheduled Capture turns the GoPro on by itself to get a shot up to 24 hours in advance. Duration Capture can capture video clips from 15 seconds to 2 hours long. Interval Photo snaps photos at fixed intervals.
  • Use the HERO13 Black as a webcam or live stream your next activity with professional features.
  • Plug your HERO13 Black in when connected to your home Wi-Fi and automatically upload your footage to the cloud. A highlight video is sent to your phone and can then be edited with beat-synced music and effects.
Improved Battery Life & Expanded Power Options
A higher-capacity 1900mAh Enduro battery gives you longer runtimes in all weather conditions. You can record 5.3K/4K video for up to 1.5 hours or 1080p video for up to 2.5 hours continuously. Additional power accessories like the Contacto Waterproof Magnetic Power Cable and Dual-Battery Charger with Integrated Powerbank offer other options to power your camera.
Waterproof Housing with Multiple Mounting Options
The camera can withstand depths up to 33′ on its own. Integrate additional mounting accessories into your camera configuration with the built-in mounting fingers, 1/4″-20 thread, and a magnetic interface compatible with the separately available Magnetic Latch Mount.

name: Hollyland LARK A2 Wireless Microphone System (Duo Version – Space Gray)
short_description:
Key Features

  • 48kHz/24 Bit
  • AI Noise Cancellation
  • Quick Charging
  • Clip-and-Go
  • AI Voice Tuning
  • AI Auto-Limit Clip
  • Safety Track
description:
Hollyland LARK A2 Wireless Microphone System (Duo Version – Space Gray) Overview

AI-Managed. Friction-Free.

AI Noise Cancellation

Built for outdoor vlogs, live streams, and short-form videos, LARK A2 features three levels of AI-driven noise cancellation, delivering up to 20 dB of noise cancellation depth for clean and clear dialogue in a variety of environments.

Low: Ideal for keeping your voice clean in quiet environments.

Medium: Designed to maintain clarity in everyday busy spaces.

High: Helps keep your voice intelligible even in challenging outdoor conditions.

AI Power Saving

LARK A2 intelligently manages power in the background, continuously adapting to your recording behavior to improve power efficiency by up to **25%**¹. This allows you to stay focused on your content without constantly worrying about battery life.

Automatic Sleep
When idle, the system automatically enters a low-power state to reduce unnecessary power consumption.

Instant Wake
Start recording instantly without waiting or additional setup.

Smart Indicator Control
Indicator lights dynamically adapt during recording to optimize power efficiency in real time.

¹ Based on Hollyland internal laboratory testing under controlled conditions. Results may vary depending on usage environment. AI Power Saving is available only when connected to a smartphone.

Pocket-Sized. Ready Whenever You Are.

Clip On. Stream Away.

Weighing just 8.5g, the LARK A2 transmitter is designed to clip securely and discreetly onto your clothing. The system comes pre-paired out of the box, so you can simply open the charging case, clip on the transmitter, and start recording.

Instant, Intuitive Control

LARK A2 puts essential controls right at your fingertips, allowing you to control key functions without interrupting your shooting workflow.

1 Press: Turn Noise Cancellation on or off
2 Presses: Mute
3 Presses: Start or stop recording

Smooth Details. Better Workflow.

Precise Gain Control

LARK A2 gives you flexible control over your recording levels to match different shooting environments.

For mobile setups, you can fine-tune the audio with up to 6 levels of gain adjustment through the HollyAudio App.

For camera setups, the system supports up to 3 levels of gain adjustment directly from the receiver, while up to 6 levels are available through the HollyAudio App on compatible mobile setups.

Frictionless Shooting

LARK A2 is designed to keep your workflow simple, with features including independent transmitter and receiver mute control, pass-through charging, MFi-certified compatibility, and plug-free playback.

Pure Audio. Perfectly Tuned.

Capture Every Vocal Texture

With 48kHz / 24-bit audio resolution, LARK A2 preserves the natural texture of your voice, delivering rich and detailed sound for vlogs, livestreams, interviews, and short-form content.

Wipe Out Background Hiss

With a ≥68dB SNR, LARK A2 helps deliver clean dialogue by minimizing unwanted static, electronic hums, and background hiss.

Handles Loud Voices with Clarity

With a 120dB Max SPL, LARK A2 can handle sudden increases in volume while maintaining smooth and natural sound. Whether you’re laughing, speaking loudly, or getting excited during a gaming stream, your recordings remain clear and detailed.

AI Voice Tuning

With a single tap in the HollyAudio App, AI-powered Voice Tuning automatically optimizes EQ, compression, and de-essing, giving your voice a polished and refined sound in seconds.

Dual Audio Insurance

AI Auto-Limit Clip

The intelligent auto-level limiter helps suppress sudden volume spikes, reducing the risk of distortion and keeping your recordings clear.

Safety Track

LARK A2 can record a secondary backup track at -6dB, providing an additional layer of protection against unexpected volume peaks and helping preserve usable audio when recording in challenging environments.

Power That Paces Your Day.

Ready for the All-Day Shoot

LARK A2 delivers up to 7 hours of continuous recording per microphone and up to 42 hours of total battery life with the charging case.

With AI Power Saving enabled, each microphone can achieve up to 9 hours of runtime, giving you even more flexibility for extended shooting sessions.

5 Minutes of Charging. 1 Hour of Shooting.

A quick 5-minute USB-C charge provides up to 1 hour of recording for the microphone.

The charging case can also provide up to 1 hour of runtime with just 10 minutes of charging, helping you get back to recording when you need it most.

Ready for Any Device

From smartphones and tablets to computers and action cameras², LARK A2 integrates seamlessly into a wide range of recording setups.

Switch between devices and recording formats effortlessly and keep your workflow moving.

² Compatibility with action cameras may vary depending on the brand and model.

Voice-Powered Vibe Coding

LARK A2 extends beyond content creation with a voice-driven experience designed for Vibe Coding. Use your voice to interact with AI, trigger commands instantly, and manage multiple AI workflows with greater flexibility.

Hands-Free AI Coding

Interact with AI using your voice without relying entirely on your keyboard. Customize shortcuts through Web Control, trigger commands with a single press, and send prompts naturally while staying focused on your workflow.

Distance-Free Voice Input

LARK A2 captures clear voice input from a distance, allowing you to interact naturally with AI even in quiet office environments where you may be speaking at a lower volume.

Multi-Agent Collaboration

Work with multiple AI agents while staying in the flow. LARK A2 supports customizable shortcuts, up to 5 preset templates, color-coded microphone indicators, and dedicated microphone assignment, allowing you to quickly switch between workflows and assign individual microphones to specific AI agents.

Keep Coding Without Interruption

With USB-C pass-through charging and adaptive mode switching, LARK A2 stays ready for both Vibe Coding and content creation, whenever you need it.

name: Tilta 95mm Circular Polarizer for Mirage Matte Box MB-T16-POLA
short_description:
Key Features
  • Circular Polarizer Filter
  • Designed for Mirage Matte Box
  • Wireless Control via Optional Motor
  • Fits Lenses with 95mm Front Diameter
  • Helps to Eliminate Reflections and Glare
  • Reduces Haze in Landscapes
  • Greater Color and Tonal Saturation
  • Can Use Lightweight Clamp-On Adapter
description:
Tilta 95mm Circular Polarizer for Mirage Matte Box MB-T16-POLA Overview

Clouds will billow off the page and a flowing stream will reveal its stony bed when using the 95mm Circular Polarizer for Mirage Matte Box from Tilta. It slides into the Mirage, or it can be clamped directly onto a 95mm lens with the Lightweight Filter Clamp-On Adapter (available separately).

The polarizer blocks the light that appears as haze in the sky or a reflection off the surface of the water. Rotate the filter, either by hand or via an optional wireless motor, to find the angle that blocks the maximum amount of unwanted light, highlighting your subject and boosting the contrast of your image.

For the Mirage Matte Box
This polarizer slides snugly into the Tilta Mirage, ensuring that a lens with a 95mm front diameter is perfectly covered. Alternatively, it can be clamped directly onto the lens via the Lightweight Filter Clamp-On Adapter (available separately).
Compatible with the Wireless Motor
The module that controls the polarizer rotation is compatible with the Tilta Wireless Motor (available separately), enabling camera operators to remotely control the polarizer’s rotation to find its maximum effect.
The Physics of Polarizers
Polarizers filter out light that has become polarized due to reflection from a non-metallic surface, like when sunlight becomes partially polarized due to reflecting off electrons in air molecules, causing the light to scatter into what appears as haze. Using a polarizer to block just those light rays results in a noticeable reduction of glare and reflections from nonmetallic surfaces and an increase in the saturation of skies and foliage.
Autofocus and Exposure Control
Linear polarizers distort the incoming light to the point that autofocus and internal light metering are negatively impacted. To correct this, circular polarizers stack a randomizing filter layer behind the polarizer to scatter the light, which enables those camera functions to perform properly.

description:
Venus Optics LAOWA 24mm T14-40 Full Frame 2x PeriProbe Cine Lens (RF Mount) Overview

The Venus Optics LAOWA 24mm T14-40 Full Frame 2x PeriProbe Cine Lens captures sharp magnified shots with full frame camera sensors using their Canon RF-mount and has a focal length of 24mm. Its periscope-style lens tube with interchangeable ends features an aperture range of T14 to T40 for a deep or shallow depth of field. Use it underwater or in tight spaces, thanks to its waterproof front barrel and slim profile.

A lens construction of 28 elements in 19 groups creates a smooth, circular bokeh with minimal focus breathing. The lens can rotate 360° along the axis to unlock the orientation ring and create spinning shots. Both the focus and iris rings have 0.8 MOD cinema-standard gears for intuitive manual controls. A 1/4″-20 thread at the end of the 15.7″ lens allows you to mount fill lights or other accessories. Built-in LEDs in the lens tips provide a ring-light effect to your shots.

Features at a Glance
  • Maximum T14 aperture for greater depth of field at close distances
  • Cinema industry-standard 0.8 MOD focus and iris gears compatible with follow focus and iris controls
  • Manually focus on objects only 0.8″ away at 2x magnification
  • Lens construction of 28 elements in 19 groups for smooth, circular bokeh
  • A wide 85° perspective to create a “bug-eye” effect
  • Long 15.7″ lens barrel for access to tight spaces, stay a safe distance from subjects
  • Waterproof front barrel for underwater shots without requiring a waterproof housing
  • 360° rotation with a clutch mechanism to adjust the orientation ring
  • Switch between 90° periscope to straight probe
  • 1/4″-20 thread for mounting of fill lights

Say goodbye to complicated clamps that scratch your phone or take forever to set up. The strong magnetic hold keeps your phone secure — even when the tripod is extended or used on uneven surfaces. 2.3 10m Bluetooth Remote Control: Flexible Shooting Without Limits

Take full control of your shots with the built-in 10m Bluetooth remote — no more rushing to set a timer or asking strangers to take your photo. The remote has a zoom wheel for precise focus, so you can capture every detail. With one button, you can switch between front and rear cameras, take photos, or start/stop videos. It even has a dedicated TikTok mode: hold down the mode button until the orange light turns on, and you can scroll up/down, play/pause, or quick-like videos effortlessly. Connecting is simple: turn on your phone’s Bluetooth, pair with “TELESIN Remote,” and iOS users just need to enable Zoom once for the first connection — no apps required.

2.4 High-Quality Materials: Stable & Durable for Long-Term Use

We built this tripod to last, using premium materials that balance durability and light weight. The body is made of aluminum alloy — strong enough to support your smartphone but light enough to carry easily. The anti-slip silicone padding protects your phone from scratches and keeps it from slipping, even on smooth surfaces. The stable support feet spread wide to create a secure base, reducing the risk of tipping over — so you can trust your phone is safe, whether you’re shooting a time-lapse or a group photo. 2.5 Extendable Design: Versatile Shooting Angles

From close-up selfies to wide-angle group shots, this extendable tripod has you covered. It extends up to 60cm (23.6in), giving you the flexibility to shoot from eye level, tall angles, or low angles — perfect for talking-head videos, travel vlogs, family photos, or time-lapses. No more limited framing — with this extendable selfie stick tripod, you can capture every moment exactly how you want it. (SEO: 60cm extendable tripod, selfie stick tripod with extendable length)

Most Android models don’t need any extra settings — just pair the remote via Bluetooth and start shooting. Whether you have a flagship Android phone or a mid-range model, this tripod is fully compatible and ready to use.

How to Use: Step-by-Step Guide

5.1 Magnetic Mounting Steps

Setting up your tripod is quick and easy — just follow these 3 simple steps: 1. Attach the included magnetic adapter ring to the back of your phone (it’s easy to install and won’t damage your device). 2. Align your phone with the magnetic mount on the tripod. 3. Snap the phone into place — it’s ready to use in just one second. No complicated clamps, no wasted time.

Built for creators who live on their phone camera

Magnetic Pro Shot Imaging Grip is designed for creators who rely on a phone grip camera setup every day:

Pro-style controls in a magnetic phone grip

Instead of tapping a slippery screen, this phone grip camera setup gives you real camera-style controls:

  • Custom Fn keys – map your most-used functions to three customizable buttons, tuned to your shooting style.

You hold your iPhone like a real camera, keep your finger on the shutter and dial, and stay focused on the scene – not fighting on-screen sliders.

AI Master Filters + Reef Color App: pro looks from a mobile phone camera grip

Paired with the Reef Color App, this phone camera grip upgrades your iPhone’s “color science”:

  • AI-trained Master Filters inspired by classic film stocks and iconic camera profiles, tuned for iPhone imaging.
  • Real-time ambient sensing automatically optimizes key parameters for the scene, helping you achieve clean, consistent results in changing light.
  • Precision filter density adjustment with the dial, so you can “ride” filter intensity in fine steps and lock in a repeatable style.
  • Dynamic OTA tuning keeps filters and algorithms evolving over time as TELESIN refines them.

The result: a camera grip for phone that lets you shoot, dial in your look and publish – without bouncing through multiple editing apps.

3200mAh battery and magnetic mount built for real shoots

Inside the grip, a 3,200 mAh battery provides hours of continuous filming and imaging. It can wirelessly charge your iPhone while you shoot, helping offset the power draw from 4K video, AI filters and high brightness.

  • Wireless charging support keeps your phone alive during long sessions.
  • High-strength magnetic mounting keeps your phone securely attached to the grip for everyday handheld use.
  • Designed for MagSafe iPhone 12 or later (iOS 26 only) – just snap on and start shooting.

This mobile phone camera grip solves both handling and battery anxiety in a single piece of gear.

Comfortable, camera-style phone grip design

The ergonomics are tuned so your phone grip feels like a compact camera in your hand:

  • Ergonomically tuned curves support different hand sizes and multi-finger holds.
  • Hand-applied leather and soft-touch surfaces provide a warm, secure feel, avoiding sharp or slippery edges.
  • Precision CNC thumb rest with anti-touch protection keeps your thumb in a dedicated zone, reducing accidental touches that could exit the camera app.

You can carry this phone camera grip all day, from commute to street shooting to night sessions, without thinking about your hands getting tired.

Ready for straps, stands and rigs

Magnetic Pro Shot Imaging Grip is not just a handheld phone grip camera accessory – it’s built to slot into your full creator setup:

  • Handle-compatible wrist strap keeps your phone safer when shooting in crowded or active environments.
  • Case-compatible shoulder strap support lets you carry your iPhone setup like a small camera.
  • Vertical stand mode lets the grip stand on a flat surface for quick talking-head videos or product demos.
  • Tripod-mountable base works with your existing tripods and mini stands for timelapses, live streams or static shots.

If you already own tripods, lights or mics, this camera grip for phone becomes a strong anchor in that ecosystem.

Why creators can trust this phone grip

TELESIN has long been trusted in the action-camera and smartphone accessory world. Magnetic Pro Shot Imaging Camera Grip continues that  as a 2026 flagship phone camera grip built from real creator feedback:

  • Developed by a dedicated imaging accessory brand with a full ecosystem of phone grips, tripods, lights and mounts.
  • Backed by the Reef Color App and ongoing firmware/app updates, so your phone grip grows smarter over time.
  • Supported by official TELESIN store warranty and after-sales service, not a one-off, unbranded phone grip camera with no roadmap.

When you choose this phone grip, you’re investing in a long-term tool – not just a temporary accessory.

How to choose your kit

Magnetic Pro Shot Imaging Camera Grip is available in two kits:

  • Standard Grip Kit – the core phone grip: grip body, wrist strap and essential accessories. Ideal if you mainly shoot in good light or already own separate lights.
  • Creator Flash Combo Kit – the full phone camera grip experience: everything in the Standard Grip Kit plus a magnetic flash and continuous fill light that integrates deeply with Reef Color, delivering brighter, more controllable lighting than the built-in iPhone flash.

description:
Tilta Expansion Accessories for Osmo Pocket 3/4 (Filter Kit) TA-T96-C Overview

The Tilta Expansion Accessories Filter Kit for DJI Osmo Pocket 4 is a streamlined accessory system designed to provide quick creative control while shooting. It combines essential filters, on-camera filter storage, built-in tripod legs, and screen protection in a compact setup.

The Tilta Base Filter Kit includes three essential filters: a Variable ND (ND2–ND32 / 1–5 stops) for flexible exposure control, a Circular Polarizer (CPL) to reduce reflections and enhance colors in skies and water, and a Black Mist 1/4 filter that reduces contrast and adds a subtle cinematic softness and glow to highlights.

All filters feature a magnetic snap-on attachment and a quick-release grooved design for fast installation and removal. Their ultra-slim construction prevents interference with lens retraction or gimbal calibration, while the high-quality optical glass is coated to resist water, oil, and scratches.

The Filter Storage Expander mounts directly to the DJI Osmo Pocket 4 and stores up to three filters on-camera. Its rotating mechanism allows quick filter selection, while the magnetic backplate enables fast filter swaps without needing a separate storage case.

The expander also features hidden tripod legs that deploy with a single tap, instantly converting the Pocket 4 into a stable desktop shooting setup.

The included Screen Protector features an AR coating that helps reduce glare while protecting the screen from scratches.

Compatibility Warning: This system is not compatible with DJI filters or other third-party filters. Only Tilta filters should be used, as using other filters may cause them to become

stuck inside the system.

short_description:
Key Features
  • Touchscreen Monitor with UHD 4K Support
  • 1000 cd/m² Brightness
  • HDMI Connectivity
  • 1000:1 Contrast Ratio
  • 10-Bit Color, Anamorphic De-Squeeze
  • 178° Viewing Angle

description:
OSEE Lilmon 5 4K HDMI Touchscreen On-Camera Monitor with Field Kit Overivew

Add a high-brightness monitor with UHD 4K support to your production kit with this Lilmon 5″ 4K HDMI Touchscreen On-Camera Monitor with Field Kit from OSEE. The compact and lightweight monitor features a bright 5.5″ 1000 cd/m² display enhanced with anti-fingerprint coating, offering a 1000:1 contrast ratio and a viewing angle of 178°. The Lilmon 5, which boasts anamorphic de-squeeze and HDMI connectivity, supports 10-bit color and HDR. It comes with a tilt arm and a cleaning cloth.
Designed for photographers, vloggers, and content creators, the Lilmon 5 meets the minimum brightness requirement for outdoor shooting and seamlessly fits into a creative’s workflow with its Swift OS touchscreen, enhancing production efficiency.
Designed for Outdoor Use
The monitor utilizes a dedicated 1000 cd/m² touch panel with low reflection, anti-fingerprint coating, and a high-efficiency backlight unit. This panel offers optimal outdoor visibility, 10-bit color precision, 1000:1 contrast ratio, and standard D65 color temperature, and it eliminates the need for a cooling fan.
Correct Color and Tone Reproduction
With 22 bits of internal processing, this color engine delivers precise color and tone rendering, enhancing fine shadow and skin tone details. OSEE’s HDR/Log mapping technology accurately maps HDR/Log signals from nearly all camera models to the display panel, ensuring correct color and tone reproduction.
Reliable and Sturdy Build for On-Location Shooting
Despite its lightweight design, the Lilmon 5 features a sturdy polycarbonate housing with a built-in aviation aluminum skeleton. The 1/4″-20 screw holes are reinforced with metal and paired with anti-rotation pin holes, ensuring reliability, especially when shooting on location.
Versatile and Flexible
The Lilmon 5 can be easily mounted on any camera configuration using its torque-adjustable tilt arm or other hot shoe mountings. It can be powered by an L-series battery at the back of a Gold or V-mount battery via an optional DC to D-Tap cable. Its compact size and light weight make it ideal for use with gimbals.

short_description:

  • Input up to 4K via HDMI & 2K via 3G-SDI

  • Power via USB-C PD, L-Series, DC Input
description:
OSEE G7 Pro 7″ Touchscreen HDMI/SDI Field Monitor with Camera Control Overview

Add a powerful, compact field monitor to your rig with the G7 Pro 7″ Touchscreen HDMI/SDI Field Monitor with Camera Control from OSEE. The G7 Pro on-camera monitor features a 7″ touchscreen with a 1920 x 1080 display and 3000 cd/m² brightness. The monitor features 3G-SDI input up to 2K and HDMI input up to UHD 4K, and both inputs also feature a loop output.
Camera Control

The G7 Pro is equipped with a USB-C port and firmware that allow you to control select cameras, providing controls such as ISO, shutter, record, focus, aperture, and more. It is currently compatible with the following cameras:

  • Canon EOS R6, R6 II, 5D Mark IV
  • Panasonic LUMIX GH5S, GH6, S5, S5 II, S5 II X
  • Sony a7 IV, a6400, ZV-E10 Mark II, FX3
  • Z CAM E2, E2C
  • Nikon Z9, Z6 II, Z6
  • FUJIFILM GFX100 II, X-T5, X-S20
Input/Output

The monitor features HDMI and 3G-SDI inputs, as well as HDMI and 3G-SDI loop outputs.

The HDMI input and output support up to DCI/UHD 4K30 resolutions, and the 3G-SDI input and output support up to 2K/HD resolutions.

Color and Brightness
The high-bright touchscreen display features 3000 cd/m² brightness, allowing you to view accurate imagery indoors or outdoors in bright sunlight. The G7 Pro supports 10-bit color depth and features a 1300:1 contrast ratio.
Power Options

You can power the monitor using the rear L-series/NP-F battery plate with a separately available battery. You can also choose to power via an optional power adapter or pro battery using the included D-Tap to DC barrel cable.

There is also a USB-C PD input that allows you to power via a separately available PD charger.

3D LUT / Camera Log Support

Numerous 3D LUTs and camera Log files are preinstalled for common camera profiles, and you can also upload up to 10 custom 3D LUTs via the SD card slot.

The monitor includes multiple standard LUTs and camera Log files, including HLG, standard Log, ARRI Log-C, Blackmagic 4K/6K Film, Canon Log-C/Log2/Log3, Fuji F-Log, Nikon N-Log, Panasonic V-Log, RED Log3G23/G10/Film, and Sony S-Log/S-Log 3.

Built-In Imaging Tools
There are numerous built-in imaging tools, including aspect, safe area, markers, anamorphic, false color, waveform, vectorscopes, histogram, focus assist, scopes, timecode, audio meter, rotate display, and more.
Rugged Design

The camera’s touchscreen is made from durable silicate glass that withstands impact and scratch damage. The chassis is made from durable, lightweight aluminum that provides protection in any production environment.

The chassis is built to withstand extreme environmental changes, and a silent fan with an automatic sensor is built in to provide additional cooling.

description:
OSEE GoStream Omni 12 ISO Live Video Hardware Switcher with ISO Recording Overview

We would like to share an update regarding the Osee GoStream Omni 12 ISO (Omni), following its introduction at NAB earlier this year. Omni is now entering a staged global rollout phase.

Due to varying product safety and regulatory certification requirements for built-in battery systems and wireless connectivity, as well as local logistics coordination, shipments will be carried out in phases across global markets. This approach ensures compliance with local regulations while maintaining consistent product quality worldwide.

Starting mid-July, selected distributors and partners in regions where certification, logistics, and other necessary requirements have been completed will begin receiving initial Omni inventory.

Omni will start entering global retail availability from August 2026. Osee Official Store (osee-tech.com), Amazon, AliExpress Official Store, and other authorized channels will become available progressively according to regional and channel schedules. Amazon US, B&H and selected channels are currently targeting availability around August 20, 2026.

Please note that all early shipments and official retail units are part of the same global product platform. To provide the best experience, users are encouraged to keep Omni updated with the latest firmware. Supporting software tools, including PC control software, overlay solutions, and companion modules, will also be available during the rollout process as part of the Omni ecosystem.

A global firmware enhancement update is planned for late July to further improve system performance and feature consistency across all units. Osee will continue supporting Omni through ongoing firmware and software updates based on user feedback and optimization.

We look forward to seeing how creators, broadcasters, and production teams bring Omni into their real-world workflows. With the support, collaboration and feedback from our global community and partners, we will continue to enhance the Omni experience and drive innovation in live production.

name: Insta360 X6 360° 8K Camera Essentials Bundle (Midnight Black)
short_description:
keyfeatures

  • For Content Creators and Videographers
  • Up to 8K50/6K60 360° Video Recording
  • 1/1.1″ Triple AI Chip Sensor
  • FlowState Stabilization, Horizon Lock
  • Multiple Filter Modes, Voice Enhancement
  • 140-Minute Runtime, Replaceable Lenses
  • Bullet Time, Time-Lapse, PureVideo Modes
  • 66′ Waterproof, 120MP 360 Photos
  • 47GB Internal Storage, microSD Slot
  • iOS/Android Companion App
description:
Insta360 X6 360° 8K Camera Essentials Bundle (Midnight Black) Overview

Upgrade your action with stylish 360° video using the powerful Insta360 X6 360° 8K Camera Essentials Bundle, which includes an extra battery, 44.9″ selfie stick, lens cap, and a battery fast-charge case. The X6 is capable of capturing HDR 8K50/6K60 360° video or 8K30 with PureVideo enhanced low-light technology in one portable action camera. The X6 offers an action-ready design with an AI-powered sensor for an intuitive approach to creating dynamic content. Features include “Bullet Time” capture, 240 Mb/s bit rates, time shift, loop recording, time-lapse, and more. The X6 also has an updated rugged design, is natively waterproof up to 66′, and has an upgraded rechargeable 2600mAh battery for an increased runtime of up to 140 minutes.
Powerful AI Sensor
The large 1/1.1″ sensor with 14.5 stops of dynamic range and a lightning-fast triple AI chip system provides a powerful hardware combination that delivers true-to-life colors, stunning clarity, and brighter, more vivid visuals.
Up to 8K 360° Capture

The X6 features ultrasharp native 8K50 or 6K60 resolution when capturing in 360 video mode, up to 8K30 resolution when in PureVideo mode, up to 8K100 resolution in Bullet Time mode, and up to a whopping 16K in time-lapse mode.

The X6 allows you to film the way you want using over 1.07 billion colors in 10-bit with your choice of color profiles, right out of the box.

Built-In Storage
With 47GB of built-in storage, you can start creating anytime, even if you forget your microSD card or run out of space on your cards.
Fast Connections
  • A built-in NFC chip wakes your X6 and connects to the Insta360 app with a quick tap
  • The X6 offers Wi-Fi 6 for up to 100 MB/s data transfer rates
  • The USB 3.1 pushes that to 450 MB/s over cable
  • Bluetooth support allows you to pair with accessories in five seconds and reconnect in one second
PureVideo Low-Light Mode
PureVideo features advanced AI noise reduction and dynamic range optimization for night vision, delivering clear, vivid footage no matter the situation or light level.
Portraits and AdaptiveTone

The X6 automatically optimizes skin tone in portrait shots for natural, true-to-life color, with no post-production needed.

AdaptiveTone 2.0 provides independent light metering for each lens to capture the full range of any environment. A new tone-mapping module preserves highlight detail, lifts shadows, and delivers cleaner color across the frame.

I-Log, LUTs, and Dolby Vision Support

Preserve your shot’s full dynamic range, perfect for those looking to lock in the details hidden in highlights and shadows using the I-Log color profile mode. Downloadable 3D LUTs allow you to grade your footage exactly how you want.

The X6 is the first 360 camera with native in-camera Dolby Vision for dynamic, precise contrast and brightness for stunning results straight from the camera.

Rugged, Replaceable Lens Design

The X6 features a replaceable lens design that lets you pop out the damaged lenses and easily snap in fresh ones with minimal downtime.

You can also say goodbye to scratches, cracks, and heartache thanks to the X6’s ultra-hard optical film, effectively resisting scratches from keys, coins, and other metals.

Multicamera Shots and Instaframe 2.0

A multicamera setup in one device, the X6 packs every possible angle into a single shot with no extra gear, no retakes, no missed moments.

With 360° video capturing everything around you, hit record and pick the best angles later with AI-powered reframing tools in the Insta360 app. Get perfectly framed video with zero editing by choosing a Selfie View or Fixed View before filming, and get an instantly sharable flat video. You can simultaneously capture a full 360° video while you capture flat video, ready for you to create additional edits or capture unexpected moments.

Ultrawide FOV

You can use the X6 like a traditional action camera and shoot crisp 5K60 first-person videos.

You can go even wider with FreeFrame Video, featuring a wide 170° field of view.

High-Quality AI 360 Photos

The X6 processes 120MP 360° photos in-camera, delivering high-quality, ready-to-share images with low noise and high-quality color.

With AI 360 Photo Frame, you can capture a 360 photo, and AI analyzes structure, subjects, and the scene, producing a flat portrait, landscape, or Tiny Planet shot.

Invisible Selfie Stick for Third-Person Views
When the X6 is attached to a selfie stick, the stick disappears in your edit, enabling you to capture aerial angles and third-person perspectives that can be achieved without a second operator.
AI Tracking Features
InstaFrame 2.0 features powerful, updated smart tracking that locks onto people, pets, or objects with one tap, providing auto-following for steady, smooth shots.
Clear Audio
The windproof 360 microphones capture sound from all directions. Intelligent noise reduction, voice enhancement, and engine-noise enhancement cut through wind and environmental noise for a superior, immersive sound, even while cycling or motorcycling.
FlowState Stabilization
From rocky roads to rolling waves, the X6 features an integrated 6-axis gyroscope for smooth and steady image stabilization, no matter what adventure you’re on.
360° Horizon Lock
No matter how the X6 is mounted, held, or utilized, your video will come out steady and balanced with the horizon with 360° Horizon Lock.
Multiple Effects Modes
  • 16K Time-Lapse: 360° time-lapse video is now available on the X6 in 16K, capturing a sweeping view over time from a stationary position
  • Tiny planet mode provides a mind-bending world overview shot
  • 8K TimeShift: Users can shoot a creative video in an easy-to-use mode with a selfie stick while walking around
Multiple Control Modes

Pair X6 with the POV Head Tracker and InstaFrame 2.0, then simply look where you want to shoot, and X6 follows. An on-screen Avatar moves with you, while footage is captured directly as flat video for fun, easy shooting.

You can use hand gestures to start/stop recording or take a photo, which is perfect for group shots, noisy locations, or mounting on a selfie stick. Full Screen Press works if you’re wearing thick gloves.

  • Voice Control 2.0 allows you to start, stop, and control X6 with your voice from a distance
  • The X6 confirms every status change with a physical buzz, even when you can’t see the screen
  • Create slow-motion video using the 8K100 Bullet Time mode, which allows you to achieve cinematic slow-motion looks using higher frame rates
  • Starlapse allows you to track star trails and nightscapes as the stars come alive
AI Director
When you don’t have time to edit and require fast offloading to your smartphone, set your X6 down to charge up while AI Director analyzes your footage, picks the best moments, and delivers a polished clip straight to your phone. Shoot now, edit never, though you can always fine-tune your footage later with Insta360’s editing tools.
FlashCut Templates

Pick a template from FlashCut’s creative library and follow the steps to create otherworldly video for fun, creative productions.

Anyone can be a content creator with X6.

Insta360 Studio App
  • Insta360 Studio and the companion app provide numerous tools to edit, adjust, and share your videos
  • With Auto Edit 2.0, select one clip or many in the Insta360 app and let AI do the rest. Framing, camera movement, cuts, music, transitions
  • AI Frame identifies the most important elements of your shot and suggests the best views. You can export without editing by picking a forward or selfie view with a single tap, and you’re done
  • Say goodbye to distortion with just one tap, for a more natural perspective for landscapes and more
  • The app provides numerous effects and features, including AI Warp, Sky Swap, Bullet Time, Starlapse, Timeshift, Time-Lapse, and Fly Lapse modes
Cloud Service and Moments Pro
The Insta360+ cloud service provides auto backup to save your files to the cloud and can clear your SD card automatically to free up space while charging. It allows you to share single clips or entire collections via a custom link. You can also edit online, anytime, anywhere, and finalize and export content without even touching your camera.
Moments Pro is a cloud-editing upgrade built for 360 video. Upload your footage, choose the subject, mood, style, and length, then get a custom video ready to share. Soon, you’ll even be able to type a description, and it’ll whip it up based on your cloud content.
2.32″ OLED Touchscreen
New high-contrast 2.32″ OLED display provides even better previews and playback. Use X6 easily in sunlight with 1200 cd/m² peak brightness and new Always‑On Display. There’s also a new under-display pressure sensor for more precise control and fewer accidental touches.
2600mAh Battery

The X6 features a higher battery capacity than its predecessor with its removable 2600mAh battery.

It has been tested to run in Endurance mode for up to 140 minutes of recording time.

Waterproof Design

Dive into the water with your X6 without a case, as the camera has been updated to be waterproof down to 66′.

It can also utilize a separately available Invisible Dive Case that allows shooting down to 197′.

Maximize the potential of your camera with the SWIT PowerCell LP-E6P USB-C Battery. Designed with a built-in USB-C charging port, this rechargeable high-current lithium-ion battery can be fully charged via USB-C in 3.5 hours or with a fast charger in just 1.5 hours.

LP-E6P Battery
for Canon Cameras

Powercell Series LP-E6P is a SWIT professional-grade camera battery for Canon cameras, built with premium cells that deliver electrical performance identical to the original battery, and features additional USB-C charging, 4-LED power indicators, engineered for professional imaging.

Canon EOS DSLR and Mirrorless Compatible

The PowerCell LP-E6P battery is backward compatible Canon LP-E6/E6N/E6NH/E6P, and can power the following cameras:
Canon EOS C50, R5 / R5M2 / R5C, R6 / R6M2 / R6M3, R7 /R7M2, R, 5DM2 /5DM3 /5DM4 /5DS /5DS R, 6D /6DM2, 7D /7DM2, 60D, 70D, 80D, 90D, and Blackmagic Design BMPCC 4K, ZCAM E2C/E2N cameras.

Premium Enduring Cells Inside

The PowerCell LP-E6P battery adopts high-quality premium cells, delivering high electrical performance and safety. They provide a constant high power load, meeting the demands of high-speed burst shooting while effectively managing heat. Especially for video recording, the long-lasting and durable nature of PowerCell batteries truly stands out.

Battery Info Reading

The PowerCell LP-E6P battery info can be read by the camera system. The discharging curve is completely identical to the original batteries, ensuring accurate display of remaining power information.

USB-C 5V Charging Input

The PowerCell LP-E6P battery can be charged directly using a USB-C charger or V-mount batteries with USB-C port or even a power bank, which is extremely convenient when filming outdoors. The batteries are compatible with their original deck chargers as well.

4-LED Touch Power Indicators

With a touch-sensitive Power Check button, you can check the remaining battery level directly, without having to insert it into the camera and check, which makes it quite convenient and clear when preparing for your next filming.

Flame-retardant, Multiple Protections

The PowerCell camera batteries feature a V0 grade flame-retardant plastic housing and integrate the same multiple protection circuits found in professional cine batteries, guaranteeing safe, reliable performance in the most demanding on-set environments.

short_description:
Key Features

• Imported AGC Optical Glass
• Self Lock Frame
• 40 Layer NANOTEC Coating
• 7.4mm Ultra Slim Frame
• CNC Non Slip Design
description:
K&F Concept 82mm Variable ND8-ND128 Filter, 28-Layer Green Coating (KF01.1080) Overview

The K&F Concept Variable ND8-ND128 Filter is made with imported AGC optical glass, providing high-quality filter material that helps maintain accurate color without noticeable color cast while preserving image clarity and sharpness.

The filter features a self-locking frame designed to avoid the common black “X” cross effect associated with variable ND filters, including when used with wide-angle and telephoto lenses.

K&F Concept’s NANOTEC multi-layer nanometer coating, with a total of 40 layers, provides waterproof, scratch-resistant, and anti-glare protection, helping protect the lens while maintaining high image quality.

The 7.4mm ultra-slim frame helps minimize vignetting on wide-angle lenses and supports focal lengths down to 40mm without vignetting. The CNC non-slip design also makes installation and removal easier.

The filter is compatible with all 82mm lenses. Please verify your camera’s lens thread size before ordering; the size is indicated by the “ø” diameter symbol. For the 82mm ND filter, the recommended lens cap/hood size is 86mm.

name: K&F Concept 49mm 2-in-1 CPL + Variable ND2-ND32 Filter 18-Layer Blue Coating (KF01.2595)
short_description:
Key Features

  • 1 to 5-Stop Light Reduction
  • Circular Polarizer Filter
  • Multicoated for Clarity and Durability
  • Cuts Reflections, Improves Contrast
description:
K&F Concept 49mm 2-in-1 CPL + Variable ND2-ND32 Filter 18-Layer Blue Coating (KF01.2595) Overview

The K&F Concept ND & CPL 2-in-1 Lens Filter combines ND and CPL functions in one filter, allowing you to control the amount of light entering the lens while darkening skies and reducing unwanted reflections from non-metallic surfaces such as water and glass. It also enhances color and contrast.

The frame features self-locking technology and rotates infinitely between 1 and 5 stops (ND2 to ND32), making it easy to position and adjust the desired light reduction while avoiding the common black “X” cross effect.

Made from HD AGC optical glass, the filter features 18 layers of multi-layer coating to effectively reduce reflections from the filter itself and minimize glare, helping maintain high image quality.

The frame is equipped with a pusher that makes it easy to adjust the ND stops. For video shooting, the pusher can also help automatically adjust the light reduction level with the assistance of an auxiliary tool.

Before purchasing, please verify your camera lens thread size. It is usually marked on the lens barrel or underneath the lens cap with a “Φ” diameter symbol, such as Φ67 = 67mm lens thread size.

name: K&F Concept Nano-X Series 2-in-1 Variable ND & CPL Filter 72mm, 2 to 6-Stop (KF01.1916)
short_description:
Key Features

  • Variable 0.6 to 1.8 Optical Density
  • 28-Layer Multicoated Optical Glass
  • Orange Levers & Self-Locking Technology
  • Trapezoidal Frame Surface Pattern
  • Oxidation Sandblasting Treatment
description:
K&F Concept Nano-X Series 2-in-1 Variable ND & CPL Filter 72mm, 2 to 6-Stop (KF01.1916) Overview

The K&F Concept 2-in-1 Variable ND + CPL Filter combines the functions of a variable ND filter and a CPL filter in one filter, providing both light reduction and improved color and contrast. The ND function offers 2–6 stops of light reduction, adjustable from ND4 to ND64, making it suitable for different lighting conditions, from cloudy days to extremely bright days. The CPL function helps remove unwanted glare and reflections from non-metallic surfaces while enhancing color and contrast.

The filter features self-locking technology with an infinitely rotatable adjustment mechanism to make light reduction and positioning easier while avoiding the common black “X” cross effect found in variable ND filters. It is especially designed to minimize this issue when using wide-angle lenses, including 16mm lenses.

Modular Full Cage
The black Full Camera Cage for Canon C50 from Tilta clads your camera in protective armor while providing a variety of accessory mounting options. This aluminum cage features a modular full/half cage design, NATO rail, shoe mount, Arca-type bottom plate, three-point mounting, HDMI and USB-C cable clamps, and multiple anti-twist 1/4″-20 and 3/8″-16 threads.
Three-Point Mounting
This cage mounts on your camera using three separate points, providing a secure fit and additional security during fast moves.

  • The top plate of the cage detaches to accommodate your camera’s original XLR handle.

Additional Details
  • Has 1/4″-20 and 3/8″-16 threads to support both horizontal and vertical capture.

Tilta Xeno Top Handle with 1/4″-20 Locating Screw (Black)

Integrate this black Tilta Xeno Top Handle into your camera cage configuration for improved low-angle shooting. The top handle secures to your cage via a built-in 1/4″-20 screw with locating pins. Multiple 1/4″-20 and 3/8″-16 threads throughout the handle allow you to attach articulating arms, cable clamps, or other accessories. The high-grade metal construction, which consists of aluminum alloy, and the unit’s nonslip coverage provide added security for comfortable handling and extended durability. The package also includes a wrist strap for improved stability and a 2′ long USB-C cable.

description:
amaran Verge Bi-Color LED Light Panel

Optimal for livestreaming, gaming, and other online activities, the charcoal-finish Verge Bi-Color LED Light Panel from amaran offers high light output with edge-lit technology to provide soft, even lighting for all kinds of content creation. The Verge is the brand’s first LED series carefully designed for desktop creators—ideal for those who desire warm-to-cool white color without giving up comfort for the eyes during long recording sessions. The slim, lightweight body of the Verge is great for various pre-recorded or live shooting scenarios. Place the LED panel directly on your desk with optional mounting accessories or use your light stand. The Verge has a well thought out design that will complement your workspace aesthetic, while it doesn’t clutter your desk, whether in a work office or in your home studio.

Bi-Color Punch
The Verge panel is a versatile LED light source measuring 11.5 x 8.7 x 1.1″ with a bi-color color temperature range of 2700 to 6500K. Light intensity is variable too with dimming from 0 to 100% intensity to serve as an adjustable key light or match the ambient light level. The Verge delivers bright illuminance of 822 lux from 3.3′ at 5600K and up to 2347 lumens.
Edge-Lit Soft Lighting
Edge-lit technology and RG0-certified, the Verge ensures soft and built-in diffused light, while providing the highest level of eye safety during long recording sessions. This means comfortable long hours of streaming sessions without eye strain. The Verge eliminates UV light, while minimizing blue light to reduce eye fatigue.
Color Accuracy
26W of maximum power and high CRI 96 and TLCI 97 ratings help accurately render color to provide natural, true-to-life skin tones and shooting effects. The Verge will benefit livestreamers, e-commerce sellers, product photographers, and any other video or photo creator working from a compact studio or home office with limited space.
FX Mode
Activate the light’s seven effects that include fireworks, faulty bulb, lightning, TV, strobe, explosion, and fire to spark creative expression.
Convenient Front-Facing Controls
Forget about hard-to-reach lighting adjustments made from the back of a light. The amaran Verge is a more convenient LED panel with intentionally front-facing controls that will facilitate your workflow. The Verge enables a polished, on and off camera appearance with quick and reliable control methods.
App Control
Make lighting adjustments locally on the light or remotely by downloading the amaran app. The app gives you fine-tune control of color, brightness, and other functionalities right from your smartphone and other devices. Users can also opt for Stream Deck compatibility or Sidus Link control options. App connectivity has a generous 328′ Bluetooth wireless range.
USB-C Power
This panel is powered by a clutter-free USB-C connection supporting PD technology. The Verge is compatible with USB-C PD3.0 power supply standards, but amaran recommends the use of the included 30W USB-C PD power adapter.
Passive Cooling
Fanless passive cooling ensures a completely silent environment for uninterrupted video recording. Whether you’re streaming, video conferencing, or recording content, the Verge silent performance helps you capture clear sound without compromise.
1/4″-20 Mounting
Rig the fixture to an optional light stand or tripod using its integrated 1/4″-20 bottom thread.
Optional Accessories
amaran also offers an optional base stand to place the light right at the top of your desk or other flat surface. The Verge is part of the brand’s Verge Lock mounting system to provide a quick and easy setup. A desk clamp stand is separately available as well, so you can clamp the light to a desk, and conveniently place it behind your computer monitor to take up minimal space.

description:
amaran Ray 660c RGB LED Monolight Overview

The full-color Ray 660c RGB LED Monolight is amaran‘s highest output COB light with 660W, OmniColor technology, and modern features. Whether you’re lighting up subjects or filling expansive studios, the Ray 660c is a well suited streamlined, monolight-style LED. Find intuitive onboard and app management of settings via FlowTurn knob and NFC configuration, or opt for DMX control via USB-C by adding an optional adapter. Choose from an extended color temperature range of 1800-20,000K in CCT+ with high color accuracy, and access 360° full color control with HSI and RGB modes. The Ray 660c is IP54 dust and watersplash resistant, so it is built to withstand demanding environments. When it comes to flexibility, amaran has left no stone unturned with the inclusion of a convenient yoke and Bowens mount compatibility. The brand includes a reflector, a single power cable, and a case to give you a storage solution and faster setup between shoots.

From Manufacturer

Meet the amaran Ray Series | An Array of Possibilities
01:00
Introducing the amaran Ray Series | An Array of Possibilities
Powerful Studio-Quality Output
The bare light delivers up to 38,500 lux at 3.3′ and 4300K, but pair it with the included reflector to increase the output to an impressive 91,600 lux at the same distance. A dedicated Fresnel is available separately to expand your creative options with a variable spot-to-flood beam. Experience 45,904 lumens, green-magenta shift, and find true-to-life colors with high CRI 95, TLCI 95, SSI 80/87, TM-30 94/100 ratings. These ratings reflect cleaner whites, true skin tones, and highly accurate colors that stay consistent on camera and to the eye.
360º Full Color
amaran’s OmniColor engine offers an enhanced color spectrum with expanded red and blue ranges for a fuller, more balanced spectrum of light. The Ray 660c has a 2300-10,000K adjustable color temperature that can be extended to a wider 1800-20,000K range in CCT+ mode. Another benefit is 0-100% stepless brightness control. The light supports 360° of color control for creating different looks, while the FX mode lets you select from 12 different effects: fireworks, faulty bulb, lightning, TV, pulsing, strobe, explosion, fire, paparazzi, welding, cop car, and party.
Adaptive Control
Other highlights are a Quick Operation mode for instant adjustments of settings, custom shortcuts for long press and double click options, as well as High-Speed Photography and Studio modes. Control is simplified with an intuitive menu and a TFT screen for quick onboard operation. A FlowTurn knob gives you tactile feedback when adjusting the lighting settings, but the Ray 660c also provides one-tap pairing to the amaran app thanks to its built-in NFC configuration. Bluetooth app control has a generous 262.5′ wireless operating range.
Optional DMX via USB-C
The Ray 660c can be integrated into optional industry-standard consoles and software with the addition of the separately available amaran USB-C to 5-pin DMX in/out adapter. When programing precise cues, syncing multi-light looks, or triggering repeatable scenes, the optional adapter for DMX control via USB-C lets you scale into more advanced studio workflows.
AC Power
amaran claims the Ray 660c as the first full color COB LED in its power class with an integrated power supply. Its convenient all-in-one body integrates power directly into the Ray 660c light head. This eliminates bulky, external power bricks, which helps you keep an efficient, clutter-free studio space. Power the light by simply using a single 16.4′ long AC power cable.
IP54-Rated Design & Low Fan Noise
With an IP54 rating ensuring dust and splash resistance and active fan cooling quiet enough for video work at 28 dBA (maximum output), with the choice of silent or smart fan modes, the Ray 360c is an ideal light for creators requiring studio-quality output whether lighting up subjects or filling small studios.
Wide Compatibility
The fixture’s metal, full-size Bowens mount is fully compatible with the included reflector, an optional dedicated Fresnel, and other Bowens modifiers. In addition, the unit’s yoke design allows for precise rotation of lamp head and comes with dual junior/baby pin receiver for quick mounting to optional stands. Finally, a safety chain bracket is built-in for added security.

name: Insta360 X6 360° 8K Camera Standard Bundle (Midnight Black)
short_description:
Key Features
  • For Content Creators and Videographers
  • Up to 8K50/6K60 360° Video Recording
  • 1/1.1″ Triple AI Chip Sensor
  • FlowState Stabilization, Horizon Lock
  • Multiple Filter Modes, Voice Enhancement
  • 140-Minute Runtime, Replaceable Lenses
  • Bullet Time, Time-Lapse, PureVideo Modes
  • 66′ Waterproof, 120MP 360 Photos
  • 47GB Internal Storage, microSD Slot
  • iOS/Android Companion App
description:
Insta360 X6 360° 8K Camera Standard Bundle (Midnight Black) Overview

Upgrade your action with stylish 360° video using the powerful Insta360 X6 360° 8K Camera Standard Bundle, capable of capturing HDR 8K50/6K60 360° video or 8K30 with PureVideo enhanced low-light technology in one portable action camera. The X6 offers an action-ready design with an AI-powered sensor for an intuitive approach to creating dynamic content. Features include “Bullet Time” capture, 240 Mb/s bit rates, time shift, loop recording, time-lapse, and more. The X6 also has an updated rugged design, is natively waterproof up to 66′, and has an upgraded rechargeable 2600mAh battery for an increased runtime of up to 140 minutes.
Powerful AI Sensor
The large 1/1.1″ sensor with 14.5 stops of dynamic range and a lightning-fast triple AI chip system provides a powerful hardware combination that delivers true-to-life colors, stunning clarity, and brighter, more vivid visuals.
Up to 8K 360° Capture

The X6 features ultrasharp native 8K50 or 6K60 resolution when capturing in 360 video mode, up to 8K30 resolution when in PureVideo mode, up to 8K100 resolution in Bullet Time mode, and up to a whopping 16K in time-lapse mode.

The X6 allows you to film the way you want using over 1.07 billion colors in 10-bit with your choice of color profiles, right out of the box.

Built-In Storage
With 47GB of built-in storage, you can start creating anytime, even if you forget your microSD card or run out of space on your cards.
Fast Connections
  • A built-in NFC chip wakes your X6 and connects to the Insta360 app with a quick tap
  • The X6 offers Wi-Fi 6 for up to 100 MB/s data transfer rates
  • The USB 3.1 pushes that to 450 MB/s over cable
  • Bluetooth support allows you to pair with accessories in five seconds and reconnect in one second
PureVideo Low-Light Mode
PureVideo features advanced AI noise reduction and dynamic range optimization for night vision, delivering clear, vivid footage no matter the situation or light level.
Portraits and AdaptiveTone

The X6 automatically optimizes skin tone in portrait shots for natural, true-to-life color, with no post-production needed.

AdaptiveTone 2.0 provides independent light metering for each lens to capture the full range of any environment. A new tone-mapping module preserves highlight detail, lifts shadows, and delivers cleaner color across the frame.

I-Log, LUTs, and Dolby Vision Support

Preserve your shot’s full dynamic range, perfect for those looking to lock in the details hidden in highlights and shadows using the I-Log color profile mode. Downloadable 3D LUTs allow you to grade your footage exactly how you want.

The X6 is the first 360 camera with native in-camera Dolby Vision for dynamic, precise contrast and brightness for stunning results straight from the camera.

Rugged, Replaceable Lens Design

The X6 features a replaceable lens design that lets you pop out the damaged lenses and easily snap in fresh ones with minimal downtime.

You can also say goodbye to scratches, cracks, and heartache thanks to the X6’s ultra-hard optical film, effectively resisting scratches from keys, coins, and other metals.

Multicamera Shots and Instaframe 2.0

A multicamera setup in one device, the X6 packs every possible angle into a single shot with no extra gear, no retakes, no missed moments.

With 360° video capturing everything around you, hit record and pick the best angles later with AI-powered reframing tools in the Insta360 app. Get perfectly framed video with zero editing by choosing a Selfie View or Fixed View before filming, and get an instantly sharable flat video. You can simultaneously capture a full 360° video while you capture flat video, ready for you to create additional edits or capture unexpected moments.

Ultrawide FOV

You can use the X6 like a traditional action camera and shoot crisp 5K60 first-person videos.

You can go even wider with FreeFrame Video, featuring a wide 170° field of view.

High-Quality AI 360 Photos

The X6 processes 120MP 360° photos in-camera, delivering high-quality, ready-to-share images with low noise and high-quality color.

With AI 360 Photo Frame, you can capture a 360 photo, and AI analyzes structure, subjects, and the scene, producing a flat portrait, landscape, or Tiny Planet shot.

Invisible Selfie Stick for Third-Person Views
When the X6 is attached to a selfie stick, the stick disappears in your edit, enabling you to capture aerial angles and third-person perspectives that can be achieved without a second operator.
AI Tracking Features
InstaFrame 2.0 features powerful, updated smart tracking that locks onto people, pets, or objects with one tap, providing auto-following for steady, smooth shots.
Clear Audio
The windproof 360 microphones capture sound from all directions. Intelligent noise reduction, voice enhancement, and engine-noise enhancement cut through wind and environmental noise for a superior, immersive sound, even while cycling or motorcycling.
FlowState Stabilization
From rocky roads to rolling waves, the X6 features an integrated 6-axis gyroscope for smooth and steady image stabilization, no matter what adventure you’re on.
360° Horizon Lock
No matter how the X6 is mounted, held, or utilized, your video will come out steady and balanced with the horizon with 360° Horizon Lock.
Multiple Effects Modes
  • 16K Time-Lapse: 360° time-lapse video is now available on the X6 in 16K, capturing a sweeping view over time from a stationary position
  • Tiny planet mode provides a mind-bending world overview shot
  • 8K TimeShift: Users can shoot a creative video in an easy-to-use mode with a selfie stick while walking around
Multiple Control Modes

Pair X6 with the POV Head Tracker and InstaFrame 2.0, then simply look where you want to shoot, and X6 follows. An on-screen Avatar moves with you, while footage is captured directly as flat video for fun, easy shooting.

You can use hand gestures to start/stop recording or take a photo, which is perfect for group shots, noisy locations, or mounting on a selfie stick. Full Screen Press works if you’re wearing thick gloves.

  • Voice Control 2.0 allows you to start, stop, and control X6 with your voice from a distance
  • The X6 confirms every status change with a physical buzz, even when you can’t see the screen
  • Create slow-motion video using the 8K100 Bullet Time mode, which allows you to achieve cinematic slow-motion looks using higher frame rates
  • Starlapse allows you to track star trails and nightscapes as the stars come alive
AI Director
When you don’t have time to edit and require fast offloading to your smartphone, set your X6 down to charge up while AI Director analyzes your footage, picks the best moments, and delivers a polished clip straight to your phone. Shoot now, edit never, though you can always fine-tune your footage later with Insta360’s editing tools.
FlashCut Templates

Pick a template from FlashCut’s creative library and follow the steps to create otherworldly video for fun, creative productions.

Anyone can be a content creator with X6.

Insta360 Studio App
  • Insta360 Studio and the companion app provide numerous tools to edit, adjust, and share your videos
  • With Auto Edit 2.0, select one clip or many in the Insta360 app and let AI do the rest. Framing, camera movement, cuts, music, transitions
  • AI Frame identifies the most important elements of your shot and suggests the best views. You can export without editing by picking a forward or selfie view with a single tap, and you’re done
  • Say goodbye to distortion with just one tap, for a more natural perspective for landscapes and more
  • The app provides numerous effects and features, including AI Warp, Sky Swap, Bullet Time, Starlapse, Timeshift, Time-Lapse, and Fly Lapse modes
Cloud Service and Moments Pro
The Insta360+ cloud service provides auto backup to save your files to the cloud and can clear your SD card automatically to free up space while charging. It allows you to share single clips or entire collections via a custom link. You can also edit online, anytime, anywhere, and finalize and export content without even touching your camera.
Moments Pro is a cloud-editing upgrade built for 360 video. Upload your footage, choose the subject, mood, style, and length, then get a custom video ready to share. Soon, you’ll even be able to type a description, and it’ll whip it up based on your cloud content.
2.32″ OLED Touchscreen
New high-contrast 2.32″ OLED display provides even better previews and playback. Use X6 easily in sunlight with 1200 cd/m² peak brightness and new Always‑On Display. There’s also a new under-display pressure sensor for more precise control and fewer accidental touches.
2600mAh Battery

The X6 features a higher battery capacity than its predecessor with its removable 2600mAh battery.

It has been tested to run in Endurance mode for up to 140 minutes of recording time.

Waterproof Design

Dive into the water with your X6 without a case, as the camera has been updated to be waterproof down to 66′.

It can also utilize a separately available Invisible Dive Case that allows shooting down to 197′.

short_description:
Key Features

  • 5K60 Open Gate (3:2) & 4K120 (16:9)
  • Internal X-OCN Raw Recording
  • Three Base ISO | Dual Gain Mode
  • 3.5″ 16:9 4-Axis Multi-Angle Touchscreen
  • AI-Powered Autofocus & White Balance
  • 5-Axis In-Body Image Stabilization
  • BIG 6 Menu System & Streamlined Controls
  • Dual CFexpress Type A/SDXC Card Slots
