description:
Canon EOS R6 V Mirrorless Camera Overview

The first V-series mirrorless camera to feature a 32.5MP full-frame sensor, the Canon EOS R6 V is designed for visual storytellers of all kinds, combining striking image quality with ergonomics tailored to video capture. Its streamlined design, in-body stabilization, and intelligent autofocus system make the R6 V equally suited for solo creators and professional productions. Boasting 7K RAW recording, impressive dynamic range, an active cooling system, and a wide range of other video-focused capabilities, the R6 V delivers consistent performance in fast-paced environments. A rotating user interface and multiple tripod mounts ensure convenient, dependable operation in horizontal and vertical shooting configurations.

From Manufacturer

23:00
Canon R6 V: Content creators, this one’s for you!
02:24
See the Features of the EOS R6 V and RF20-50mm F4 L IS USM PZ in Action
32.5MP Full-Frame Sensor and DIGIC X Processing
Built around a 32.5MP full-frame CMOS sensor with a powerful DIGIC X image processor, the R6 V captures exceptionally sharp, low-noise imagery in a wide variety of high-quality video formats. The sensor’s 6960 x 4640 resolution allows for 7K raw video recording, as well as 7K oversampling for 4K video with superior detail and color reproduction. Effective across a spectrum of different lighting scenarios, the R6 V has a native ISO range of 100 to 64,000 that is extendable to 50 to 102,400, with 15+ stops of dynamic range in Canon Log 2.
7K RAW Video Recording
With an expansive array of video resolutions and formats, the R6 V maximizes flexibility in post-production. Internal 7K30 open gate RAW and 7K60 RAW Light recording formats provide deep 12-bit color and razor-sharp detail, permitting advanced color grading and precise cropping in post without sacrificing quality. Custom Picture can be activated using the dedicated color button, allowing direct access to Canon Log 2, Canon Log 3, HLG, PQ, Canon 709, BT.709, and 14 additional user-assignable profiles. High frame rates up to 4K120 and 2K180 deliver striking slow motion, expanding creative possibilities and enhancing footage of fast-moving subjects.

 

  • 6960 x 4640 (3:2) open gate RAW recording up to 29.97 fps
  • 6960 x 3672 (17:9) DCI RAW Light recording up to 59.94 fps
  • 4096 x 2160 (17:9) and 3840 x 2160 (16:9) oversampled video up to 59.94 fps
  • 4096 x 2160 (17:9) and 3840 x 2160 (16:9) video up to 120 fps
  • 2048 x 1080 (17:9) and 1920 x 1080 (16:9) video up to 180 fps with 1.13x crop
  • 12-bit RAW, 10-bit XF-HEVC S/H.265, and 8/10-bit XF-AVC S/H.264 formats
Hybrid Functionality
Ideal for solo videographers, filmmakers, and photographers that require hybrid versatility, the R6 V retains many of the still-image-capturing abilities of its photo-focused counterpart, the R6 Mark III. Its electronic shutter allows for continuous shooting at up to 40 fps and features a Pre-Continuous Shooting mode that captures an additional 20 frames prior to the shutter button being fully pressed.
Dual Pixel CMOS AF II
Carried over from the EOS R6 Mark III, the Dual Pixel CMOS AF II system is a rapid, responsive, and precise focusing system for both stills and video. Engineered to recognize people, animals, vehicles, and more, this intelligent phase-detection system locks onto subjects and tracks them during movement. Advanced functions such as Register People Priority allow specific prioritization of subjects for unmatched accuracy.
  • Multiple autofocus settings for still images and video, including One-Shot, AI Focus, Servo, and Movie Servo AF
  • Phase-detection system with intelligent subject detection that recognizes people, animals, and vehicles
  • Register up to 10 people in-camera using photographs to prioritize them over other subjects in crowded scenes
  • Movie Servo AF offers cinematic focus pulls and customizable speed, sensitivity, and priority settings
  • Additional focus settings, including Eye Detect AF, Touch AF, and a variety of manual options with focus peaking
Comprehensive Image Stabilization
Featuring Coordinated Image Stabilization, the R6 V combines its In-Body Image Stabilizer (IBIS) with optical IS in compatible Canon RF and RF-S lenses, creating a multifaceted stabilization system that corrects up to 7.5 stops of camera shake at the image center for smooth video and sharp stills. In addition to sensor-shift IS, the R6 V offers Movie Digital IS, a five-axis digital image stabilization function that moves the captured image across the CMOS imaging sensor to keep footage steady in highly unstable shooting scenarios.
Practical Design
Engineered for video capture, the R6 V sports a sleek, versatile body design that puts functionality first. A built-in active cooling system boosts continuous performance, while convenient physical controls and a vari-angle LCD with a rotating UI make camera configuration an intuitive experience.
  • Active cooling system allows two or more hours of recording in 7K RAW Lite for long productions
  • 3″ 1.62m-dot vari-angle LCD provides the flexibility to film from any angle with a clear display
  • Power zoom lever for precise zoom control built directly into the camera
  • Dedicated color mode button for rapid switching between color profiles
  • Integrated tally lamp provides a clear visual indicator when recording
  • 1/4″-20 female threads on the bottom and side for horizontal and vertical tripod mounting
Connectivity
The R6 V features extensive wired and wireless connectivity options, including dual memory card slots, a USB-C port, and a full-size HDMI that supports 7K ProRes RAW external recording to compatible Atomos Ninja monitor/recorders.
  • CFExpress Type B slot supports memory cards up to 8TB in size for high bitrate video recording
  • SDXC UHS-II memory card slot for redundancy, sub recording, or proxies
  • Full-size HDMI port ensures a stable external recording, streaming, or monitor connection
  • USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 port for power input, 10 Gb/s data transfer, and streaming via UVC/UAC
  • Dual 3.5mm jacks for microphone input and headphone monitoring
  • Built-in Wi-Fi 5 and Bluetooth 5.1 for camera control, file transfer, and mobile app operation

Its electronic shutter allows for continuous shooting at up to 40 fps and features a Pre-Continuous Shooting mode that captures an additional 20 frames prior to the shutter button being fully pressed.
Dual Pixel CMOS AF II
Carried over from the EOS R6 Mark III, the Dual Pixel CMOS AF II system is a rapid, responsive, and precise focusing system for both stills and video. Engineered to recognize people, animals, vehicles, and more, this intelligent phase-detection system locks onto subjects and tracks them during movement. Advanced functions such as Register People Priority allow specific prioritization of subjects for unmatched accuracy.
  • Multiple autofocus settings for still images and video, including One-Shot, AI Focus, Servo, and Movie Servo AF
  • Phase-detection system with intelligent subject detection that recognizes people, animals, and vehicles
  • Register up to 10 people in-camera using photographs to prioritize them over other subjects in crowded scenes
  • Movie Servo AF offers cinematic focus pulls and customizable speed, sensitivity, and priority settings
  • Additional focus settings, including Eye Detect AF, Touch AF, and a variety of manual options with focus peaking
Comprehensive Image Stabilization
Featuring Coordinated Image Stabilization, the R6 V combines its In-Body Image Stabilizer (IBIS) with optical IS in compatible Canon RF and RF-S lenses, creating a multifaceted stabilization system that corrects up to 7.5 stops of camera shake at the image center for smooth video and sharp stills. In addition to sensor-shift IS, the R6 V offers Movie Digital IS, a five-axis digital image stabilization function that moves the captured image across the CMOS imaging sensor to keep footage steady in highly unstable shooting scenarios.
Practical Design
Engineered for video capture, the R6 V sports a sleek, versatile body design that puts functionality first. A built-in active cooling system boosts continuous performance, while convenient physical controls and a vari-angle LCD with a rotating UI make camera configuration an intuitive experience.
  • Active cooling system allows two or more hours of recording in 7K RAW Lite for long productions
  • 3″ 1.62m-dot vari-angle LCD provides the flexibility to film from any angle with a clear display
  • Power zoom lever for precise zoom control built directly into the camera
  • Dedicated color mode button for rapid switching between color profiles
  • Integrated tally lamp provides a clear visual indicator when recording
  • 1/4″-20 female threads on the bottom and side for horizontal and vertical tripod mounting
Connectivity
The R6 V features extensive wired and wireless connectivity options, including dual memory card slots, a USB-C port, and a full-size HDMI that supports 7K ProRes RAW external recording to compatible Atomos Ninja monitor/recorders.
  • CFExpress Type B slot supports memory cards up to 8TB in size for high bitrate video recording
  • SDXC UHS-II memory card slot for redundancy, sub recording, or proxies
  • Full-size HDMI port ensures a stable external recording, streaming, or monitor connection
  • USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 port for power input, 10 Gb/s data transfer, and streaming via UVC/UAC
  • Dual 3.5mm jacks for microphone input and headphone monitoring
  • Built-in Wi-Fi 5 and Bluetooth 5.1 for camera control, file transfer, and mobile app operation

description:
Sony FE 100-400mm f/4.5 GM OSS Lens (Sony E) Overview

Professional Super-Telephoto Zoom
A long-reaching and highly versatile lens, the Sony FE 100-400mm f/4.5 GM OSS is the super-telephoto zoom built without compromise; it’s designed to meet the needs of the professional wildlife, birding, sports, and journalism photographers. Thanks to a portable design with internal zoom and focus, as well as the renowned G Master optical capabilities, this constant maximum aperture zoom offers the performance and rendering required for photographing small and distant subjects at high speeds with high precision.
G Master Optical Performance
Sony’s G Master designation is reserved for its highest performing optics, those that offer the greatest sharpness, smoothest bokeh, utmost speed, and best overall performance. This 100-400mm f/4.5 checks all of these boxes as it sets out to be a single lens replacement for several telephoto primes.
  • Constant f/4.5 maximum aperture is more intuitive than the 100-400mm f/4.5-5.6 GM predecessor, offering faster performance at the long end of the range while still contributing to a portable, handholdable design.
  • Bright-enough design is suitable for working in ambient conditions, especially when paired with the OSS, and it also offers greater control over depth of field and subject-background separation.
  • ED XA, XA, Super ED, and ED elements yield high sharpness and smooth rendering that suits distant and backlit subjects, especially when working with busy backgrounds and strong lighting.
  • Nano AR Coating II suppresses flare for rich contrast and bright colors in a variety of lighting conditions.
  • Floating focus design maintains high image quality throughout the focusing range, resulting in matched sharpness from infinity to the 2.1′ minimum focusing distance.
  • Rounded 11-blade diaphragm results in smooth, circular bokeh quality.
High-Speed AF, Reliable OSS
Primarily designed for speed, precision, and reliability, the focusing and stabilization systems benefit wildlife, sports, and journalism applications. Additionally, the lens is well-suited to hybrid applications, including wildlife and sports videography.
  • Four XD (extreme dynamic) linear motors generate fast and responsive AF performance that’s equally quiet and smooth. The focusing system is compatible with continuous shooting speeds up to 120 fps or high-speed video recording at up to 240 fps.
  • Compared to the previous 100-400mm f/4.5-5.6 GM, this lens’s AF speeds are approximately 3x faster, tracking performance has improved by 50%, and subject tracking is more accurate thanks to new algorithms.
  • Internal focusing design promotes quicker focusing speeds and maintains the lens length during use.
  • Internal zoom maintains the overall length of the lens during operation, as well as keeps a consistent center of gravity for easier use on a tripod, especially with gimbal heads.
  • Focus breathing has been greatly reduced optically and the lens supports the Breathing Compensation function in select cameras to effectively eliminate angle of view shifts while changing the zoom position.
  • Maximum magnification of 0.25x, along with the 2.1-4.9′ minimum focusing range, suits working with close-up subjects at near-macro magnification.
  • Manual aperture ring offers tactile exposure control and the ring can be de-clicked for smooth and silent iris pulls or it can be locked in the ‘A’ position for camera-based aperture switching.
  • The lens weighs about 4 lb, however much of this weight is at the rear of the lens for a balanced design that promotes comfortable handheld use.
  • An advanced Optical SteadyShot image stabilization system ensures sharp imagery while shooting handheld at even the longest focal lengths. Multiple modes are available, including standard (Mode 1), panning (Mode 2), and moving subjects (Mode 3).
Intuitive Operability and Design
Despite a long-reaching super-telephoto range, internal zoom/focus design, and relatively bright f/4.5 constant maximum aperture, the lens still manages to be portable and usable atop a tripod, monopod, or even handheld.
  • Measuring 12.9″ long and weighing about 4 lb, this lens is approximately 5″ longer and nearly 1 lb heavier than the FE 100-400mm f/4.5-5.6 GM OSS lens while managing to add internal zoom and focus designs and a constant f/4.5 maximum aperture.
  • Accepts both 40.5mm rear drop-in filters, via the included holder, and 95mm front screw-in filters.
  • Four programmable focus hold buttons and a focus mode switch for intuitive focus control.
  • Customizable Function Ring can be assigned to control a variety of camera and exposure settings.
  • Dust- and moisture-resistant design includes rubber gaskets at each seam and a rubber ring sealing the lens mount for ensured use when working in inclement weather conditions.
  • Hybrid construction uses both metal and plastic components to maximize both durability and a low weight design.
  • Front lens element has a fluorine coating that repels water, oil, and other contaminants and makes the lens easier to clean.
  • Removable tripod collar has a clicking design to help align when rotating between horizontal and vertical shooting orientations.
  • Included lens hood features a locking button and a filter window for easier adjustment of rotating filters (e.g. polarizers, variable NDs).
Teleconverter Compatibility
The FE 100-400mm f/4.5 GM OSS is compatible with the optional Sony FE 1.4x and 2.0x teleconverters. These teleconverters can be used while still retaining full autofocus and auto-exposure capabilities. When used, the 1.4x and 2.0x teleconverters will provide effective focal lengths and apertures of 140-560mm f/6.3 and 200-800mm f/9, respectively.

short_description:
Key Features

  • Dual Lenses, 1″ & 1/1.3″ CMOS Sensors
  • Detachable 2″ OLED Screen

description:
Insta360 Luna Ultra Standard Combo (Stellar White) Overview

The Luna Ultra from Insta360 is an AI-powered gimbal camera capable of capturing up to 8K30 video thanks to its Leica-engineered optics. The Luna Ultra features two lenses, one with a 1″ CMOS image sensor and one with a 1/1.3″ CMOS sensor. A triple AI chip ensures efficient low-light performance. The 2″ OLED touchscreen on the camera can actually detach to function as a wireless remote for control over distance. AI-powered tracking and rapid focus protocols keep your subjects in focus even during fast-action sports.
Triple AI Chip
The Luna Ultra comes equipped with a triple AI processing chip, two of which are dedicated to imaging for superior low-light performance. The other chip provides processing power for the rest of the camera’s functions.
High-Quality Imagery
Dual Leica-engineered lenses with professional imaging chips support up to 8K30 Dolby Vision video, 4K120 slow motion, and 4K60 PureVideo. The pro-grade telephoto lens can facilitate up to 12x zoom and 6x lossless zoom for crisp close-ups.
Enhanced Low-Light in PureVideo Mode
In tandem with the triple AI chip system and PureVideo mode, the Luna Ultra can capture up to 4K60 video in low-light environments with reduced noise and enhanced brightness and detail.
Realistic Portrait Capture
Film 4K60 portrait videos and 4K Live Frame photos all from a single device. Beauty Mode refines skin texture and brightens complexions.
Detachable 2″ OLED Touchscreen
The Luna Ultra’s detachable 2″ OLED touchscreen supports HD video signal transmission up to 65’for remote viewing and control. A built-in wireless microphone in the component records clear dialogue even at a distance.
Scenic Panoramic Images
The Luna Ultra can support still images up to 37MP, but in scenic panoramic mode, those capabilities expand to 200MP for crystal clear details.
Deep Track 5.0 AI Tracking
Reliable AI tracking is enabled thanks to Deep Track 5.0 protocols. Auto-tracking can be toggled via the joystick or by selecting your subject on the camera touchscreen to keep that subject centered in frame. Active Zoom tracking follows the action, even when your subject leaves the frame. Group tracking keeps multiple people in frame. Smart Framing overlays a 3×3 grid of golden-ratio points and allows you to select a preset position to keep your framing consistent throughout.
Comprehensive Audio Connectivity
A 4-microphone array—three built into the camera and one in the detachable handle—captures high-quality audio with ease. A preinstalled wind guard reduces wind noise for a more natural sound. Connect wireless transmitters via Bluetooth using compatible Insta360 Mic Air or Mic Pro units.
Built-In Professional Color
Built-in Leica color profiles and cinematic filters create baked-in professional looks for your footage. The Luna Ultra also features 10-bit I-Log and up to 14 stops of dynamic range for rich highlights, shadows, and color detail.
Insta360 App & QR Color Share
The Insta360 mobile app offers ready-made templates and AI-powered editing to pick out your best moments, turning them into ready-to-share edits. Share your color profiles as QR codes and let other Luna Ultra users scan them directly with their camera’s lens and emulate your style.
All-Day Battery Life & Internal Storage
Record for long periods of time with the 4-hour battery life, thanks to the camera’s internal 1550mAh battery. The battery recharges up to 80% in just 23 minutes via USB-C. The 47GB of internal storage lets you start shooting right away, with the option to expand via the microSD card slot.

description:
Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Ultimate Kit (1-10 Stops VND, CPL, Black Mist) TF-MFK-B Overview

Designed for for photography and cinema lenses with 77mm or 82mm front filter threads, the Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Ultimate Kit offers a versatile combination of filters, adapters, and protective covers in a compact and portable stack. The kit includes magnetic front and back covers and a soft carrying case to protect the filters during storage and transport.

The foundation of this kit is the circular polarizer (CPL) filter which magnetically connects to the included adapter rings and comes in three different variations. All three CPLs rotate to produce accurate and vibrant colors by limiting reflected light and preventing unwanted glare caused by reflective surfaces.

Tilta Illusion Magnetic Circular Polarizer Filter

Designed for the Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Ecosystem, this Circular Polarizer Filter reduces reflections and glare from surfaces such as glass and water. It preserves natural color depth and contrast to create photographs with greater color and tonal saturation. It features a dual-security system in its magnetic attachment with mechanical locking.

 

Tilta Illusion Magnetic Circular Polarizer & Black Mist 1/4 Filter

Designed for the TiltaIllusion Magnetic Filter Ecosystem, this 2-in-1 Circular Polarizer & Black Mist 1/4 Filter produces a softer, more diffused cinematic look in addition to reducing reflections and glare, and preserving natural color depth. It lowers contrast and produces a subtle glow around light sources, while limiting overall softness and retaining contrast in the shadows.This filter features a dual-security system with magnetic attachment and mechanical locking.

 

Tilta Illusion Magnetic Circular Polarizer with ND32 Filter (1 to 5-Stop)

Designed for the Illusion Magnetic Filter Ecosystem, the Tilta Illusion Magnetic Circular Polarizer with ND32 Filter is a combined polarization and neutral density filter. It ensures true color reproduction while providing 1 to 5 stops of light reduction, reducing glare and reflections from water or glass. It also increases image saturation and vibrancy.

Additional Details
  • No color cast
  • Minimal vignetting
  • Repels water and oil
  • Easy to clean
Tilta Illusion Magnetic Variable ND Adapter for Circular Polarizer Filter

Designed for the Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Ecosystem, this Variable ND Adapter for Circular Polarizer Filter enables creating variable neutral density configurations. Its cinema-grade, full-spectrum coating delivers low reflectivity and even light transmission, preserving the true color of every scene.

When combined with the optional Illusion Magnetic CPL, the adapter allows users to to make adjustments between one and five stops and maintain consistent exposure when lighting conditions change unexpectedly. For 6-to-10 stop exposure control, pair this adapter with the optional ND32-integrated CPL.

Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Protective Front Cover

Designed for the Illusion Magnetic Filter Ecosystem, the Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Protective Front Cover magnetically locks onto your filter, protecting it from dust, impact, moisture, and scratches. It enables working quickly without fumbling with traditional snap-on caps.

Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Protective Back Cover

Designed for the Illusion Magnetic Filter Ecosystem, the Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Protective Back Cover magnetically locks onto your filter, protecting it from dust, impact, moisture, and scratches. It enables working quickly without fumbling with traditional snap-on caps.

Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Adapter Ring (77mm)

Designed for the Illusion Magnetic Filter Ecosystem, the Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Adapter Ring threads onto the front of your lens, allowing you to attach a magnetic filter. This lightweight aluminum design does not add any significant bulk to the lens and enables fast and secure filter changes in the field.

Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Adapter Ring (82mm)

Designed for the Illusion Magnetic Filter Ecosystem, the Tilta Illusion Magnetic Filter Adapter Ring threads onto the front of your lens, allowing you to attach a magnetic filter. This lightweight aluminum design does not add any significant bulk to the lens and enables fast and secure filter changes in the field.

Tilta Armor Man 3.0 Gimbal Support System ARM-T03 Overview

The Tilta Armor Man 3.0 allows you to attach a gimbal and achieve even better stability with it while taking its weight off your arms. It supports most full-size gimbals on the spring-loaded arms, including the Tilta Gravity, Freefly MoVI, and DJI Ronin. You’ll be able to boom the gimbal down as far as possible to the ground, with your focus more on the shot than on the weight of the gimbal and load. You can also easily adjust camera settings, as the Armor Man pretty much holds your gimbal up all on its own, leaving your hands virtually free.

Shock-Absorbing Arms
Two shock-absorbing mechanical arms attach to the back of the adjustable vest or the top of the vest in high mode. Each arm has two adjustable tension knobs that allow you to set the tension in relation to the weight of your gimbal rig as well as your preferred operation style.
Supported Gimbal Types
The system supports top-bar gimbals or gimbal ring system via the included adapters/clamps. Alternatively, handlebar-based gimbals can be attached via optional Armor Man 3.0 Support Cups.
Arms Removable between Shots
In between shots, you’re able to remove the arms from the vest by pulling the arm release cords (in standard mode). When you’re ready to operate again, simply reengage the arms and reattach your gimbal.

DJI Osmo Mobile 8P – 3-Axis Smartphone Gimbal for Professional Video Stabilization

The DJI Osmo Mobile 8P is a compact and powerful smartphone gimbal designed to deliver smooth, cinematic video content with ease. It is ideal for content creators, vloggers, and anyone looking to capture professional-quality footage using their mobile phone.

The Osmo Mobile 8P allows you to control your shots remotely, making it easy to capture selfies, group shots, and creative angles with precise framing and minimal effort.

The device supports direct native tracking for faster response and more reliable performance, allowing seamless subject detection without complicated setup or external tools.

3-Axis Mechanical Stabilization
Equipped with a 3-axis stabilization system, the Osmo Mobile 8P eliminates unwanted shakes and vibrations, delivering stable and cinematic footage in any shooting condition.

Long Battery Life and Phone Charging
The gimbal offers up to 10 hours of battery life, making it suitable for extended shooting sessions. It also supports phone charging, so you can continue recording without interruptions.

Creative Shooting Modes
Capture unique and dynamic content with creative shooting options such as low-angle shots and orbit movements, helping you produce more engaging and professional videos.

Shooting and Editing Tutorials
Built-in tutorials provide step-by-step guidance on shooting techniques and video editing, helping users improve their skills and create better content.

Integrated Extension Rod and Tripod

The formfitting aluminum cage features a 1/4″-20 camera screw, two locking side plates to prevent twisting, multiple 1/4″-20 and 3/8″-16 ARRI-style accessory threads, a NATO rail, a QD (Quick Detach) port, and strap slots. The top handle provides additional shoe mounts and mounting threads, and the side handle provides additional mounting options and comfortable handheld support to the side of the cage.

Custom-fit to select Sony a7 models, this Full Camera Cage from SmallRig protects your camera while providing a myriad of mounting points for customizable gear configurations. The design of the cage maintains access to the camera’s buttons and ports thanks to a hinged arm for battery replacement, among other custom details. Multiple 1/4″-20 threads and ARRI anti-twist 3/8″-16 threads throughout the cage offer mounting points for articulating arms. Two cold shoe mounts and a HawkLock-style NATO rail can accommodate wireless transmitters, fill lights, or side handles. The bottom of the cage features an Arca-type quick release plate for easy integration onto a tripod or stabilizer. The cage’s overall aluminum alloy and stainless steel construction creates a durable and lightweight design, and rubber pads on the interior protect the camera from scratches.

The clamp is designed to prevent the HDMI cable from pulling or accidentally disconnecting. It mounts onto the side of the cage using one 1/4″-20 screw, which is secured with two anti-twist pins to prevent twisting. The cables are secured with an easy-grasp, knurled 1/4″-20 screw. name: Hollyland Pyro Ultra 4K HDMI/SDI Wireless Video Transmission System
short_description:
Key Features
  • Wireless Transmitter and Receiver Set
  • Transmit UHD 4K60 Video up to 4900′
  • HDMI/SDI Inputs and Outputs
  • TWiFi Technology with Frequency Hopping
  • Broadcast and Focus Modes
  • Supports UVC and RTMP for Streaming
description:
Hollyland Pyro Ultra 4K HDMI/SDI Wireless Video Transmission System Overview

Add up to 4K60 wireless video transmission to your production using the versatile Pyro Ultra 4K HDMI/SDI Wireless Video Transmission System from Hollyland. The system includes a wireless transmitter, a wireless receiver, different-sized antennas, a USB-C adapter, a D-Tap to DC cable, a DC power adapter, and a dual ball head to cold shoe mount adapter. HDMI and SDI ports accept line-of-sight transmission from up to 4900′ away. TWiFi transmission technology creates a composite link with automatic frequency hopping for exceptional clarity and a low 20 ms latency. Additional operating modes make for increased capabilities depending on the needs of your production. The Pyro Ultra is backwards compatible with the entire Pyro family to work seamlessly with your preexisting workflows.
Unlimited Linking
The Pro Ultra ecosystem can be expanded to include unlimited receivers getting footage from a single transmitter unit, all while continuing to deliver stable wireless signals.
TWiFi Transmission Technology
TWiFi is Hollyland’s new proprietary codec that creates a composite link out of 2.4 and 5 GHz wireless signals for secure communications. The system can then ensure line-of-sight transmission up to 4900′. On top of this, automatic frequency hopping avoids signal interference in crowded network environments. Dynamic Frequency Selection unlocks more of the wireless spectrum in regulated regions for additional flexibility.
Broadcast Mode
When enabled, Broadcast mode delivers real-time signal monitoring to a wide variety of receiver units from 2300′ away. When deactivated, the standard setup supports up to six monitoring screens—four receivers and two mobile apps—up to 4900′.
Focus Mode
When trying to complete precise focus pulls, Focus mode maintains a low latency to ensure a responsive monitoring environment. Latency varies depending on the output resolution of your footage, measuring 20 ms at 1080p30, 40 ms at 1080p60, and 45 ms at 4K60.
Flexible Streaming
The Pyro Ultra features both UVC and RTMP streaming. Plug-and-play connectivity and flexible platform compatibility make the receiver ideal for live production and remote collaboration.
Freeze Frame
The system automatically freezes the last frame on screen when an unexpected cut occurs to give production crews time to recover. You can even set up a custom image as a default display to maintain visual consistency.
Adaptive Output Resolution
The receiver automatically adapts its HDMI or SDI output resolutions to match downstream devices, ensuring compatibility across setups.

name: Insta360 X5 360 Action Camera Essentials Bundle
short_description:
Key Features

  • For Content Creators and Videographers

  • 360° Post Reframing, Even Longer Runtime
  • Rugged Design, Removable Lens Guards
  • Gesture Control, Dual/Single Lens Modes
  • Bullet Time, Time-Lapse, InstaFrame
  • Active HDR, Loop Recording, Me Mode
  • 49′ Waterproof, 72MP Photos
  • App with Edit Suite and Effects
  • Invisible Selfie Stick Feature
description:
Insta360 X5 360 Action Camera Essentials Bundle Overview

8K30 360° PureVideo

The X5 features ultrasharp 8K resolution, which is 78% more pixels than 5.7K for greater detail and clarity, making reframed video on par with standard camera footage for easier matching edits.

PureVideo features advanced AI noise reduction and dynamic range optimization that deliver clear, vivid footage, no matter the situation or light level.

Powerful AI Algorithms

Larger 1/1.28″ sensors and a lightning-fast triple AI chip system set a new benchmark for 360° capture. This powerful hardware combination delivers true-to-life colors, stunning clarity, and brighter, more vivid visuals.

The X5 uses supersampling from 11K to 8K, making it more detailed and delivering truly immersive clips. Active HDR Mode is now upgraded to 60 fps to capture stunning details and colors in highlights and shadows, and it delivers superb stabilization even in action-packed moments.

Rugged, Replaceable Lens Design

The X5’s new replaceable lens design lets you pop out the damaged lenses and easily snap in fresh ones with minimal downtime.

You can also say goodbye to scratches, cracks, and heartache thanks to the X5’s ultra-hard optical film, boasting a 100% improvement in drop resistance compared to X4, effectively resisting scratches from keys, coins, and other metals.

Multicamera Shots and Instaframe Mode

A multicamera setup in one device, the X5 packs every possible angle into a single shot—no extra gear, no retakes, no missed moments.

With 360° video capturing everything around you, hit record and pick the best angles later with AI-powered reframing tools in the Insta360 app. Get perfectly framed video with zero editing by choosing a Selfie View or Fixed View before filming, and get an instantly sharable flat video. You can simultaneously capture a full 360° video while you capture flat video, ready for you to create additional edits or to capture unexpected moments.

Ultrawide POV

You can use the X5 like a traditional action camera and shoot crisp 4K60 first-person videos. You can go even wider with MaxView in FreeFrame Video, featuring a 170° FOV in 4K30.

The X5 processes 72MP photos in-camera, delivering high-quality, ready-to-share images with low noise and high-quality color.

Wind Guard and Clear Audio

Shredding trails or riding waves, your audio stays crystal clear with the new multilayer Wind Guard with steel mesh that silences wind gusts. The X5’s upgraded audio algorithm cuts through wind and environmental noise for a superior, immersive sound, even while cycling or motorcycling.

A new intelligent audio mode that clarifies voices without the need for any extra microphones, perfect for vlogging.

Invisible Selfie Stick for Third-Person Views
When the X5 is attached to a selfie stick, the stick disappears in your edit, enabling you to capture aerial angles and third-person perspectives that can be achieved without a second operator.
AI Gesture Control
You can now use hand gestures to start/stop recording or take a photo, which is perfect for group shots, noisy locations, mounting on a selfie stick, when wearing thick gloves, or simply not disturbing others in the area with sound such as voice control.
Time-Lapse, Time Shift, Bullet Time Modes
  • 11K Time-Lapse: 360° time-lapse video is now available on the X5 in 11K, capturing a sweeping view over time from a stationary position.
  • 8K TimeShift: Users can shoot a creative video in an easy-to-use mode with a selfie stick while walking around.
  • Get “Bullet Time” (reference from The Matrix) slow-motion video using the 5.7K120 Bullet Time mode on the X5, which allows you to achieve cinematic slow-motion looks using higher frame rates and resolutions.
Insta360 App
  • Insta360 Studio and the companion app provide numerous tools to edit, adjust, and share your videos.
  • AI Frame identifies the most important elements of your shot and suggests the best views. You can export without editing by picking a forward or selfie view with a single tap, and you’re done, with no more waiting around.
  • Use the virtual joystick or move your phone to reframe your videos, sharing your edits instantly.
  • Say goodbye to distortion with just one tap, for a more natural perspective for landscapes and more.
  • The app provides numerous effects and features including AI Warp, Sky Swap, Bullet Time, Starlapse, Timeshift, Time Lapse, and Fly Lapse modes.
Insta360 Cloud
  • Automatically backs up your files to the cloud—accessible on any device—and can auto-delete them from the SD card to free up space.
  • Share your world instantly with a customizable link.
  • Send single or multiple clips at once to friends, family, and followers.
  • Edit and export on the cloud, anytime, anywhere.
  • Leave the app running in the background and use your device uninterrupted.
2.5″ Touchscreen
The bright touchscreen is made from durable Gorilla Glass and features a large 2.5″ size, and it allows you to control the camera, select shooting modes, change settings, preview your images and footage, and more.
2400mAh Battery
The X5 features a higher battery capacity than its predecessor with its removable 2400mAh battery. It has been tested to run at 5.7K30 360° video mode for up to 135 minutes of recording time. In Endurance mode, it can record 5.7K30 for up to 185 minutes, and in 8K30 mode, it can run for up to 88 minutes.
FlowState Stabilization
From rocky roads to rolling waves, the X5 provides smooth and steady image stabilization, no matter what adventure you’re on.
360° Horizon Lock
No matter how the X5 is mounted, held, or utilized, your video will come out steady and balanced with the horizon with 360° Horizon Lock.
Waterproof Design

Dive into the water with your X5 without a case, as the camera has been updated to be waterproof down to 49′.

It can also utilize a separately available Invisible Dive Case that allows shooting down to 197′.

Snap-On Mounting
Switch your X5 setup in a flash with an all-new magnetic mounting system. Quick mounting is designed for activities like cycling when you want shots from multiple positions and need quick adjustments. The battery can be swapped in and out easily, making sure you always stay powered up.
Capture Modes
  • Twist to Shoot Mode: Simply rotate your selfie stick back and forth twice to start/stop filming or take a photo. There’s no need to take your gloves off when you’re on the slopes.
  • Gesture Control: The handiest way to shoot, this mode allows you to film and take pics using only your palm and the peace sign.
  • Voice Control 2.0: Say hello to true hands-free filming with an advanced voice control algorithm.

name: OSEE GoStream Duet 8 ISO 8-Channel Live Stream Switcher
short_description:
Key Features

  • Multisource Live Stream Switcher
  • Four Physical and Four Stream Inputs
  • HDMI, SDI, NDI, RTMP, and SRT Support
  • Two XLR Mic or 3.5mm Audio Inputs
  • PGM and 8-Channel ISO Recorders
  • Stream Deck and Companion Support
  • Built-In T-Bar
  • One Upstream and Two Downstream Keyers
  • 8-Layer Composition Engine
  • Multi-Platform Streaming Supported
description:
OSEE GoStream Duet 8 ISO 8-Channel Live Stream Switcher Overview

The GoStream Duet 8 ISO 8-Channel Live Stream Switcher from OSEE is a versatile, multisource live stream switcher with four physical inputs and four stream inputs. Boasting HDMI, SDI, NDI, RTMP, and SRT connectivity support, the switcher also offers two XLR microphone inputs and two 3.5mm audio inputs that may be selected as needed. The GoStream Duet 8 is brimming with essential production tools, including PGM and 8-channel ISO recorders, one upstream and two downstream keyers, and a built-in T-bar. There is also a 3.5mm headphone audio jack on the rear of the unit for quick and easy monitoring.
Flexible Physical and Stream Inputs
Connect IP cameras, PTZs, webcams, camcorders, mirrorless and SDI cameras, and remote guest connections without external converters, with comprehensive support for 3G-SDI, 4K HDMI, USB 3.0, NDI|HX, SD/SSD playback, SRT/RTMP, web browsers, and PNG images.
PGM and 8-Channel ISO Recorders
The GoStream can record all video inputs, program output, and audio. The recorders support MP4 H.264 recording and include two built-in MP4 video players for H.264 video file playback.
Support for Professional Audio
You can select to use the two built-in XLR microphone inputs or 3.5mm audio inputs to deliver professional-grade sound in podcasting. Condenser and dynamic microphones can be used, and the XLR inputs integrate 48V phantom power. A studio-grade preamp supports up to 75 dB of low-noise gain for sensitive microphones.
Next-Level Layout and Graphics Overlay
Multisource connectivity is augmented with four configurable windows, background or foreground, which are ideal for use in church video applications, podcasts, online meetings, remote guest and panel discussions, and TV-style professional live production. Two downstream keyers offer support for logos and lower-third overlays, while one upstream keyer aids flexibility for green screen keying, pattern, and PiP (Picture-in-Picture). Control offered via a web browser gives you access to dynamic overlays and real-time maps.
Multi-Platform Streaming and Worldwide Collaboration
The GoStream Duet 8 allows you to simultaneously stream to three different platforms. It can also extend connectivity to a multiview monitor, a PGM display, and a video wall.
Auto-Switching
Auto-switching allows the video switcher to automatically change video sources based on the audio signal. When the audio source changes, the video follows, allowing for seamless transitions without manual intervention. It allows for two-line audio detection auto-switching and can switch between close-ups, wide shots, and SuperSource.
Wide Range of Control Options
The GoStream Duet 8 can be controlled via its internal menu, and it offers Stream Deck and Companion support.

description:
Godox Litemons LA300Bi Bi-Color LED Monolight (Black) Overview

Suitable as a fill light source for video shooting, the Litemons LA300Bi Bi-Color LED Monolight from Godox has an adjustable bi-color CCT while providing you with NFC functionality for quick app control. Even in its compact white housing, the LA300Bi is a 330W unit capable of delivering a bright output when equipped with the included reflector. Among its many benefits are 11 built-in lighting effects for simulating various creative scenes and dimming capability. On the rear of the unit is a convenient screen for monitoring the parameters of the light, complemented by local buttons and a knob for easy tweaks. Godox’s Litemons LA series offers a space-saving lighting solution for interviews, live streaming, and all types of content creation.

Bi-Color Punch
For your convenience, the LA300Bi supports dimming or adjusting the bi-color color temperature from 2800 to 6500K.
Color Accuracy
The fixture boasts high color accuracy, rating at 95 for both CRI and TLCI standards. Additionally, green-to-magenta shift is available for color correction.
NFC Connection
NFC connection makes it easy to connect the light with the Godox app. Simply bring your smartphone closer to the NFC spot on the rear of the fixture, and the app will connect automatically. The app gives you the option to manage the light via Bluetooth from up to 98.4′ away. It makes it much easier to synchronize and control multiple lights at once and even provides remote operation of various lighting effects.
AC or Optional Battery Power
The LA300Bi runs on AC power using its included power adapter and cable. The unit can also be powered by optional V-mount batteries, making the LA300Bi suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.
Enhanced Versatility
Utilizing a Bowens standard mount, the LA300Bi is compatible with an extensive selection of optional light modifiers.
Safety
Included are a fixing band and a wire rope to let you attach the power supply to the fixture or to protect the light by securing it even more.

Viltrox AF 35mm F1.2 LAB Full-Frame Lens for Sony E-Mount Overview

Classic Focal Length, Intuitive Controls

name: OSEE GoStream Deck 4K HDMI/USB Live Streaming Video Switcher
short_description:
Key Features

  • Supports up to 1080p60 Video
  • 4 x HDMI and 1 x USB-C Input
  • 2 x HDMI and 1 x USB-C Output
  • Stream to Three Platforms Simultaneously
  • 2 x Mic Inputs, Embedded HDMI Audio
  • SD Card Slot
  • Merge Video Sources, 6-Layer Composition
  • 8 Custom Macro Memories
description:
OSEE GoStream Deck 4K HDMI/USB Live Streaming Video Switcher Overview

Facilitate engaging livestreams with a portable gear configuration using the OSEE GoStream Deck Video Switcher thanks to its HDMI/USB connections compatible with portable monitors and livestreaming cameras. The switcher features four HDMI inputs and one USB-C input that interface with two HDMI outputs and one USB-C output. Both the input and output ports support up to 1080p60 video. An SD card slot allows for direct recording and playback to a connected monitor without requiring a separate PC. Stream via RTMP and Ethernet connection to up to three social media platforms.

From Manufacturer

GoStream Deck Instant Recording & Playback
Streamline Your Livestream Production
The GoStream Deck’s comprehensive control panel, built-in user interface, and SD card recording and playback function reduces the number of required devices needed to facilitate your livestream. This keeps your production low cost and efficient.
Supports Three Simultaneous Streams
Livestream to three different platforms simultaneously using the integrated Ethernet port on the GoStream. Connect a USB webcam to the USB-C input and output that feed via OBS, VMix, or Zoom using the USB-C output port.
Versatile Interface
Additional ports on the switcher allow you to expand your setup to best suit your production. Connect up to five video input sources like cameras and UVC sources and output them to a monitor or projector for simultaneous presentation.
Built-In Audio Mixer
An internal audio mixer supports seven channels of embedded and input audio sources, with four audio sources coming from the HDMI inputs, one from the AUX input, and two from dedicated 3.5mm TRS microphone ports. Mix the inputs into the program output using the On/Off or AFV controls on the switcher and adjust parameters like gain, balance, and fade. Monitor audio from a selected source using the headphone input.
Unified Video Integration
Using the Super Source feature, merge two video windows and one background video into a unified single source. The source then becomes a standard video input integrated into the composition engine. Select source material from video inputs or internally generated still image signals. Modify the layout, size, position, and border of each window.
6-Layer Composition Engine, Macro Presets
The GoStream supports six layers of special effects including Super Source, upstream keyers, downstream keyers, Chroma keyers, transitions, and a still image generator. Craft visually appealing, multi-layered effects tailored to your production. Use the eight Macro Memories to record specific composition functions and set them as custom presets for efficient recall.

name: SWIT Crew T1R1 – 1.2km/4000ft Pro Wireless Video Transmission
short_description:
Key Features

  • Professional wireless RF transmission (NOT WiFi)
  • Proprietary Anti-Interference RF for stable performance
  • 5GHz License-Free DFS Compliant
  • Auto Scan & Optimal Channel Selection
  • Supports 3G-SDI & HDMI® HD Video Transmission
  • Up to 1.2 km / 4000 ft Line-of-Sight range
  • USB-C Video Capture for PC/Mac
  • H.265 up to 26.8Mbps Visual Lossless
  • 32ms Ultra Low Latency
  • 1T to 4R Multicast support
  • MetaData & Timecode Trigger transmission
  • High Bright OLED Display & Configuration
  • AES-256 Dual Encryption for secure transmission
  • Flexible power options: NP-F / 2-pin LEMO / USB-C
description:
SWIT T1R1 – 1.2km/4000ft Pro Wireless Video Transmission Overview

KUWI 2.0 Pro Wireless Video Transmission is a professional-grade wireless video solution designed for filmmakers, broadcasters, and live production teams who demand reliable, high-quality transmission. Operating on proprietary RF technology (not WiFi), it delivers stable HD video up to 1.2 km / 4000 ft line-of-sight, with ultra-low latency of just 32ms.

The system supports 3G-SDI and HDMI® video inputs and outputs, and features USB-C Video Capture for PC/Mac integration. With AES-256 dual encryption, KUWI 2.0 Pro ensures secure and private transmission. The high-bright OLED display makes configuration easy, and the auto-scan function selects the optimal channel for interference-free operation.

The system supports 1 Transmitter to up to 4 Receivers (1T-4R Multicast), enabling multi-receiver setups without compromising video quality. It also supports MetaData and Timecode Trigger transmission, allowing synchronized production workflows.

1.2km Long Range Wireless Video

Professional RF, NOT WIFI

The new generation CREW wireless system, upgraded with twice longer transmission distance, enhanced reliable image quality, and uncompromised multicast capabilities. The CREW system continues to deliver the same rock-solid transmission stability as FLOW series, for professional broadcast and film productions.

KUWI 2.0 Professional Chip, Stable As Always

The New Generation KUWI2.0 professional chip for wireless video, 5765-5840MHz License-Free, inherits the stability advantages of SWIT wireless products, ensures the stable transmission in the most complex environment.

Professional Video Production Applications

The CREW series Wireless System is engineered for exceptional stability and reliability, the solution for professional video productions like sports broadcast productions, cinematic filmset shooting and high end event productions. CREW ensures seamless, real-time transmission with minimal latency and zero signal dropouts, providing production teams with the confidence and flexibility needed for flawless on-set and on-location workflows.

Reliable 1.2km Long Distance Transmission

CREW features advanced video codec and optimized intelligent RF power, enabling transmission range of up to 1.2 km (4000 ft) in line of sight, to significantly expand the monitoring coverage, provide greater flexibility and freedom for live video production.

32ms Consistent Low Latency

The ultra-low latency has exceeded the limits of human visual perception, achieving visually lossless performance, suitable for the professional wireless follow focus, the most demanding application in terms of latency.
The latency is consistent, never changed regardless of the environment interference. In multi-camera productions, using CREW would ensure the strict synchronization among the multiple wireless channels.

Uncompromised 1T to 4R Multi-Cast

The CREW supports 1 Transmitter to up to 4 Receivers Stable Multi-Cast Transmission, with no compromise on Distance, Latency or Video quality for film crew application. All the CREW family Tx and Rx are fully cross-compatible for multicast.

3G-SDI / HDMI / UVC

The Transmitter:
3G-SDI in×1, loop out×1, HDMI in×1
The Receiver:
3G-SDI out×2, HDMI out×1
USB-C Video Capture out×1
* Whether Tx input SDI or HDMI, all Rx interfaces can output simultaneously.

USB-C Video Capture

For PC/Mac Livestreaming

The CREW wireless receiver provides USB-C port video capture output, and can be connect to a computer for ivestreaming productions, 1080P50/60 High Quality Video Capture, Driver-free for both PC and Mac.

USB-C Video Capture

Monitor by Smart Devices

Connect CREW Receiver to a smart phone or tablet via USB-C port, to watch the camera video wirelessly instead of a pro video monitor.
* Compatible with all 3rd party “USB camera” APP.

Visually Lossless High Video Quality

The CREW series wireless transmission adopts H.265 High Quality Encoding, bit rate up to 26.8 Mbps, visually lossless compared to cable video.

Display and Configuration

High Bright Color OLED Screen

Both the Tx and Panel Rx Wireless is equipped with a high bright 450nits OLED screen that remains clearly visible even in direct sunlight. It displays essential transmission status information such as video format, frequency channel, signal strength, etc. A user-friendly joystick allows for easy configuration of all functions, including Tx/Rx pairing, channel switching, fan on/off control, firmware upgrades, and more.

MetaData Transmit

CREW supports to wirelessly Transmit SDI embedded MetaData from cine cameras, for DIT livegrading, record and manage the camera information.

TimeCode Trigger Transmit

The CREW wireless system also supports the transmission of SDI embedded timecode and Start/Stop trigger from the camera.

Dual Encryption protection

The CREW wireless system has Dual Encryption protection:
1. Use exclusive KUWI chip of proprietary RF;
2. Adopt AES-256 high level encryption
to ensure that the video signals captured on movie sets are not leaked to third parties.

Multiple Power Supply

The CREW wireless can be powered up by NP-F battery or D-tap to 2-pin LEMO cable that provided in package.
You can also power the CREW conveniently via its USB-C port.

Group Tagging

4 colors Tags are provided to be placed on the antennas. Different pairing groups of Tx and Rx are distinguished by different colored Tags.

Backup High Gain Antennas

CREW standard antennas are soft-base 3dBi gain, transmit a reliable 900m range in line-of-sight. The package also provides 4× 5dBi high-gain backup antennas that can prolong the distance to 1.2km and improve wall-cross stability.

description:
Canon RF 50mm f/1.4 L VCM Lens (Canon RF) Overview

The Canon RF 50mm f/1.4 L VCM is a versatile, high-performance prime lens designed for both photography and video applications, making it an excellent choice for creators using full-frame RF-mount cameras. With its bright f/1.4 maximum aperture and 11-blade diaphragm, the lens excels in low-light conditions while producing smooth, cinematic bokeh that enhances subject separation and visual depth.

Built with a hybrid design, the lens incorporates a Voice Coil Motor (VCM) for video-friendly rear focusing, paired with a Nano USM system for fast, precise, and near-silent autofocus. This combination ensures smooth focus transitions for video and accurate performance for still photography. A dedicated manual iris ring and AF/MF switch provide intuitive control, allowing quick adjustments during shooting.

Optically, the lens is engineered for exceptional image quality, featuring one ultra-low dispersion (UD) element and two aspherical elements to reduce chromatic aberrations and maintain sharpness across the frame. Advanced coatings, including ASC (Air Sphere Coating), SSC (Super Spectra Coating), and fluorine coating, effectively minimize ghosting and flare while enhancing contrast and clarity.

As part of Canon’s premium L-series, the RF 50mm f/1.4 is built for durability and reliability, with a weather-resistant construction that protects against dust and moisture in demanding shooting environments. Additional features such as a customizable function button, a minimum focusing distance of 15.7 inches, and a 67mm filter thread further enhance its usability and flexibility.

Combining speed, precision, and professional-grade optics, the Canon RF 50mm f/1.4 L VCM is a powerful all-around lens for portraits, video production, and everyday creative work.

Compact, multifunctional, and creator-friendly, the Godox MA5R RGB LED Light & Power Bank is a powerful portable lighting tool that enhances your content while keeping your phone powered throughout the day.

short_description:

description:
Canon EOS C50 Full-Frame Cinema Camera Overview

The Canon EOS C50 Cinema Camera is a compact yet powerful hybrid production camera designed for filmmakers, content creators, and hybrid shooters who require exceptional video performance alongside high-resolution photography. Built around a newly developed 7K full-frame CMOS sensor, the C50 delivers outstanding image quality with low noise and an impressive 15+ stops of dynamic range, allowing creators to capture cinematic visuals across a wide range of lighting conditions.

The camera supports 3:2 Open Gate recording using the full sensor area, giving filmmakers greater flexibility when cropping or reframing footage in post-production. It can record RAW video up to 7K at 60 fps and 4K video at up to 120 fps, enabling both high-resolution capture and smooth slow-motion performance. Hybrid creators can easily switch between dedicated photo and video modes, with the camera capable of capturing 32MP still images, making it ideal for productions that require both formats.

For precise subject tracking, the C50 features Dual Pixel CMOS AF II, delivering fast, reliable autofocus with advanced face, eye, and subject detection. Built-in tools such as simultaneous 2K crop recording allow creators to instantly generate vertical or square formats, simplifying the process of producing content optimized for social media platforms.

Designed for professional workflows, the camera includes Frame.io Camera-to-Cloud integration, enabling immediate transfer of proxy files for faster collaboration and post-production. It also supports XC Protocol, allowing remote camera control over IP networks for multi-camera productions or studio environments.

The included detachable top handle enhances the camera’s versatility with dual 3-pin XLR inputs for professional audio capture and convenient onboard controls for quick adjustments during handheld shooting. Compact, powerful, and highly adaptable, the Canon EOS C50 is an ideal solution for creators who need cinematic image quality and hybrid shooting capabilities in a portable production camera.

description:
RODE Wireless GO Gen 3 – 2-Person Wireless Mic System (Black) Overview

The RODE Wireless GO (Gen 3) is a powerful and ultra-compact dual-channel wireless microphone system engineered for professional content creators, filmmakers, streamers, and podcasters who need dependable performance and exceptional sound quality. Designed for maximum flexibility, it combines advanced recording technology, extended wireless range, and intelligent audio control in a sleek, portable form factor.

One of its standout features is 32-bit float onboard recording, providing an enormous dynamic range that virtually eliminates the risk of digital clipping. As long as the microphone capsule itself is not overloaded, your recordings remain clean and distortion-free. Low-level recordings can also be safely normalized without introducing unwanted noise. With 32GB of internal memory, each transmitter can capture up to 40 hours of backup recording, ensuring your audio is always secure.

The transmitters feature upgraded built-in microphones—derived from the Wireless PRO series—offering improved clarity, better intelligibility, and enhanced resistance to overload for cleaner sound at the source. For added versatility, locking 3.5mm inputs allow secure connection of external lavalier microphones, making the system suitable for both built-in and professional lav setups.

RODE’s intelligent GainAssist technology automatically adjusts output levels to match your camera based on your subject’s volume, removing guesswork and helping you maintain balanced audio. Manual control is also available, with up to 30 dB of adjustment and dedicated gain presets for various camera types.

Powered by upgraded Series IV 2.4 GHz digital transmission, the Wireless GO (Gen 3) delivers an impressive wireless range of up to 853 feet (260 meters) with improved signal stability in busy RF environments. The system supports simultaneous dual-transmitter operation without compromising range performance. Built-in 128-bit encryption ensures secure and reliable transmission worldwide without licensing concerns.

The receiver includes a high-power headphone output for real-time monitoring, a clear and upgraded display for checking levels and recording status, and flexible connectivity options including 3.5mm TRRS analog output and USB-C digital audio output. This allows seamless integration with cameras, computers, and mobile devices. The system is fully compatible with RODE Central and RODE Connect software for advanced customization, onboard file management, safety track recording, and multi-channel streaming setups.

Compact enough for run-and-gun shooting yet powerful enough for professional production, the RODE Wireless GO (Gen 3) delivers broadcast-quality wireless audio with advanced backup recording, intelligent gain control, and extended range—making it an essential tool for modern creators.

description:
RODE Wireless Micro Dual USB-C Wireless Mic (Black) Overview

The RODE Wireless Micro is an ultracompact dual wireless microphone system designed to deliver high-quality, hands-free audio for mobile video production, livestreaming, and content creation. Built specifically for creators on the move, it includes two lightweight clip-on transmitters with built-in omnidirectional microphones and a dual-channel receiver that plugs directly into the USB-C port of your Android or compatible iOS smartphone or tablet. The system pairs automatically when powered on, providing fast setup and reliable wireless transmission at distances up to 328 feet (100 meters).

Each miniature transmitter offers a discreet, low-profile design that can be clipped onto clothing or mounted using the included magnetic attachments, ensuring flexible and wardrobe-friendly placement. The built-in electret-condenser microphones feature a forgiving omnidirectional pickup pattern that captures sound evenly in a 360° radius, maintaining consistent audio levels even when the speaker turns away from the mic. Powered by internal rechargeable batteries, each transmitter operates for up to 7 hours on a single charge. The included charging case provides two additional full charges, delivering up to 21 hours of total recording time—ideal for long shoots and extended production days.

The compact dual-channel receiver connects directly to your mobile device’s USB-C port, drawing power without the need for extra cables and keeping your setup clean and streamlined. Designed to handle sound pressure levels up to 135 dB and offering a full 20 Hz to 20 kHz frequency response, the Wireless Micro captures clear, broadcast-ready audio with impressive detail and clarity. It is fully compatible with the free RODE Capture app, making professional-quality mobile recording easier than ever.

For even greater flexibility, the system also supports direct Bluetooth connection to compatible Apple smartphones via the RODE Capture app, allowing you to record premium wireless audio without using the receiver.

Complete with magnetic mounts, furry windshields for outdoor use, a sleek charging case, and a USB-C charging cable, the RODE Wireless Micro provides a compact, reliable, and creator-friendly solution for capturing professional sound anywhere.

description:
RODE VideoMic Pro+ Camera-Mount Shotgun Microphone Overview

The RODE VideoMic Pro+ is a compact and versatile shotgun microphone designed for mobile journalists, vloggers, filmmakers, and run-and-gun shooters who need professional, directional audio in a lightweight camera-mount form. Smaller than its predecessor yet packed with expanded features, it delivers exceptional sound performance whether mounted on a camera or used on a boompole.

Utilizing a supercardioid polar pattern, the VideoMic Pro+ focuses on sound directly in front of the microphone while reducing noise from the sides and rear. Its low-noise condenser capsule captures detailed, broadcast-quality audio that significantly outperforms standard built-in camera microphones. An integrated Rycote Lyre shockmount minimizes vibration and handling noise, while the redesigned foam windscreen reduces wind interference, making it ideal for both indoor and outdoor recording.

The microphone offers flexible powering options to suit any production setup. It includes the LB-1 rechargeable lithium-ion battery, delivering up to 100 hours of operation per charge. Alternatively, it can run on two AA batteries or be powered via USB from an external battery pack. An automatic power on/off function helps conserve battery life by syncing with compatible cameras, while manual control remains available when needed.

For precise audio control, the VideoMic Pro+ features a three-stage gain adjustment (+20 dB, 0 dB, -10 dB), allowing optimal signal levels whether connecting directly to a camera or to a dedicated preamp. A selectable high-pass filter at 75 Hz or 150 Hz reduces low-frequency noise such as traffic or air conditioning, while a high-frequency boost enhances clarity and speech intelligibility. The built-in safety channel records a secondary track at -10 dB to prevent distortion from sudden loud sounds, providing extra security during unpredictable shoots.

A 3.5mm TRS output with dual-mono configuration ensures seamless connection to cameras and portable recorders, and compatibility can be expanded with optional adapters for smartphones or XLR-equipped devices. Informative LED indicators clearly display battery status, gain settings, filter modes, and safety channel activation, with automatic brightness adjustment based on ambient light.

Compact, durable, and engineered for reliability, the RODE VideoMic Pro+ is a powerful solution for creators who require professional, directional sound capture in a flexible and travel-friendly design.

description:
FUJIFILM X-M5 Black with XC 15-45mm Lens

The FUJIFILM X-M5 Black is a compact yet powerful mirrorless camera built for creators ready to step beyond smartphone content. Featuring a 26.1MP APS-C X-Trans CMOS 4 sensor and advanced X-Processor 5, the FUJIFILM X-M5 Black delivers professional image quality, stunning color reproduction, and exceptional low-light performance in a lightweight body.

Paired with the versatile XC 15-45mm f/3.5-5.6 OIS power zoom lens, this kit is perfect for photography, vlogging, travel, product reviews, and social media content.

Bigger Sensor, Better Image Quality

The FUJIFILM X-M5 Black uses a large APS-C sensor that captures over 16 times more light than a typical smartphone sensor. This results in:

  • Richer, more accurate colors

  • Greater detail and dynamic range

  • Improved low-light performance

  • Beautiful background blur and subject separation

The unique X-Trans pixel design reduces digital artifacts and creates more natural tonal transitions for a cinematic look straight out of camera.

6.2K Open-Gate Video for Creators

Designed with modern content creators in mind, the FUJIFILM X-M5 Black records stunning 6.2K open-gate video using the full 3:2 sensor. It also supports:

  • 4K video at 60fps

  • Full HD up to 240fps for smooth slow motion

  • Dual Log modes for professional color grading

Dedicated Vlog features make self-recording simple:

  • Background Defocus for cinematic blur

  • Product Priority mode for review videos

  • Portrait Enhancer with adjustable skin smoothing

  • 9:16 vertical Short Movie mode for social media

A visible red frame indicator confirms recording is active.

AI Autofocus with Subject Detection

Powered by X-Processor 5, the FUJIFILM X-M5 Black includes advanced AI-based autofocus with:

  • Eye and face tracking

  • Intelligent subject recognition

  • Fast and accurate continuous focus

Whether shooting yourself, moving subjects, or product demonstrations, focus remains sharp and reliable.

20 Film Simulations with Legendary Color Science

FUJIFILM is known for its iconic film looks, and the FUJIFILM X-M5 Black includes 20 Film Simulation modes. Create classic cinematic styles directly in camera, reducing editing time.

Additional creative controls include:

  • Grain Effect for vintage texture

  • Color Chrome and Color Chrome Blue for deeper tonal response

  • Quick access via dedicated top dial

Compact, Lightweight, and Creator Friendly

Weighing just 12.5 oz without a lens, the FUJIFILM X-M5 Black is the smallest and lightest X Series body. Its 3 inch fully articulating touchscreen is ideal for vlogging and self-recording.

Connectivity and workflow features include:

  • Built-in WiFi and Bluetooth

  • Frame.io Camera to Cloud support

  • Single SD card slot, UHS-I compatible

  • Up to 45 minutes of continuous 6.2K recording

  • Approximately 440 still images per charge

Included XC 15-45mm f/3.5-5.6 OIS Power Zoom Lens

The included XC 15-45mm lens provides a 23-69mm equivalent focal range, ideal for landscapes, portraits, travel, and everyday content.

Key lens features:

  • Smooth electronic power zoom with dual speeds

  • Optical Image Stabilization with 3-stop shake reduction

  • Aspherical and extra low dispersion elements for sharp images

  • Super EBC coating to reduce flare and ghosting

  • Fast and quiet autofocus for photo and video

  • Retractable design for compact storage

The FUJIFILM X-M5 Black with XC 15-45mm lens is the perfect all-in-one mirrorless kit for creators who demand portability, professional image quality, and powerful video performance.
